description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.

title: German Speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR), Part-time
description:
We recently expanded into Germany and we are now hiring a part-time Sales Development Representative. Your job is to find German companies that would be a good match for HR-ON’s software solutions for recruitment and core HR, start the conversation, and book the meeting for sales. We don’t know everything yet, and you will be part of shaping the future strategy of our German market expansion.


About the team

In the office you'll spend the most of your time with the Sales Development team: you, one German-speaking SDR and two colleagues covering Denmark. You'll also join the German Squad, consisting of six German-speaking colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success whose job is to make this market work.

With value based self-management at the core of how we work at HR-ON, you are responsible to your team as we don’t have the typical hierarchy. That means great freedom and great responsibility.


What you’ll do
  • Calling and emailing companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, in German
  • Booking meetings for our sales team to close
  • Following up on leads from campaigns, webinars and events
  • Trying different messages and target groups, and keeping track of what actually works
  • Keeping the CRM in a state where a colleague can pick up your conversation


Do you recognise yourself?

This is an entry level position, so what matters more for this role than your previous experience is that you can say yes to the following statements:

  • I can hold a conversation with someone who wasn't expecting to hear from me, and I don't take a no personally
  • I keep asking questions until I understand, and I can explain something complicated back in the other person's words rather than my own
  • I don't need a manager checking up on me to deliver, and when I'm stuck, I ask instead of waiting
  • I get better results with a team around me, and I keep working on getting better at what I do
  • I speak and write German fluently


What we offer
  • A culture and environment that values output and impact, no matter the title or seniority. That means you can gain experience with tasks and take on responsibilities that are typically reserved for leadership in traditional organisations.
  • A thorough onboarding program and in-house sales training to give you the skills you need to thrive in your role
  • Become part of a team where we take our work seriously while still having fun.
  • Flexible working hours
  • Value-based self-management where mutual trust and transparency come first.


Practical information

Start date: as soon as possible

20 to 25 hours a week, spread how you like, as long as a decent share lands inside German office hours. The job is based in Odense, and we'd like you here at least two days a week. Exact days are agreed with your team.


How we hire

So you know what to expect when you apply:

  • Three short questions and your CV instead of a cover letter
  • A 30-minute screening call.
  • An interview with the team in Odense, including a 20-minute case you receive in advance
  • A decision within a week, and an answer to every candidate either way


Sounds like you?

We read applications as they arrive, so send yours when it is ready rather than waiting for a deadline, and we get back to every single candidate.

Click "apply" to send your application.


About us

HR-ON has grown from a start-up in Odense into one of Europe's most comprehensive HR technology providers, serving more than 600 customers, and we are still accelerating.

HR-ON covers the whole employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding through wellbeing, time registration, employee data and offboarding.

At HR-ON, employees have the freedom to manage their own working time. This means unlimited holiday and parental leave, as well as full flexibility regarding working hours and remote working.

Our employee manifesto outlines a forward-thinking approach to working life, shifting focus from time to results, from control to trust, and from hierarchy to open dialogue. We call this approach value-based self-management because it is based on trust and a shared set of values.

Read more about our Employee Manifesto HERE

title: TEAM Coordinator for production at MotilityCount ApS
description:
MotilityCount ApS is an ambitious company with both scientific and commercial expertise in fertility. We are located in Valby, Copenhagen, have about 30 employees.

We are an international company and our ambition is to raise awareness of male fertility and enable more couples to realise their dream of having a child – "sooner rather than later". In a world of increasing fertility challenges, we know that "Every Day Counts".

The company primarily sells two products: the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test for home use and the SwimCount™ Harvester for clinical use. For each of the two product areas, we have a TEAM Coordinator in production.

As our current TEAM Coordinator for the production of SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test is retiring and in the future only wants to continue on reduced hours, we are looking for a new TEAM Coordinator who will take the lead in the daily operations and take responsibility for products and deliveries being completed on time. You therefore take responsibility for the daily coordination of our operations. The right candidate will be an active part of the production of the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test and as a playing coach creates motivation, well-being and development among the company's employees in production.

In addition to being at the forefront of production, you must be able to contribute by ultrasonic welding, applying labels, filling syringes and packing in both primary and secondary packaging on day and evening shifts, respectively.

The production manufactures goods both for stock and for specific customer orders. It is therefore important that you can show great flexibility and ensure that deadlines are met. This applies not least to specific orders to the USA, where we must comply with agreed delivery dates to our American importer and distributor, who delivers on to major American retailers and webshops, among others.

Your tasks

  • Be highly visible in production, support employees in doing their work and create direction in everyday life.

  • Handle production planning, staffing, division of work, training and follow-up on the employees' work.

  • Plan and coordinate production tasks and staffing so that deadlines are met.

  • Coordinate with production management and QA with a focus on quality, efficiency and deadlines.

  • As a playing coach, you can actively participate in the TEAM's daily production work together with 10-12 production/packaging employees.

  • Be responsible for the daily distribution of the tasks and follow-up on the TEAM's tasks and results.

  • Focus on safety, quality and proper craftsmanship.

  • Follow up on and order production materials from suppliers.

  • Contribute to a strong team spirit and good cooperation in production.

Your qualification

We imagine that you have a technical background and solid experience with tasks in a Medical Device production similar to the production at MotilityCount ApS.

You thrive in the role of playing coach, take the lead, are visible in production and motivate employees through presence and professional sparring. At the same time, you are practically oriented and ready to show how the tasks should be carried out.

You will not have personnel management, as the employee management and financial responsibility are handled by Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach.

You can read and understand technical SOPs, have knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and generally have a good understanding of technical solutions.

You are accommodating, good at listening and able to create trust. At the same time, you work in a structured way and follow the tasks all the way through – even when it is busy. You believe that the best results are created through a strong team spirit and good cooperation. IT is a natural part of your daily work.

We offer

  • A TEAM Leader-Coordinator role with daily management and coordination of 10-12 employees, where you combine professionalism with responsibility for people and processes.

  • A production in good development, where you get the opportunity to put your stamp on the direction.

  • A working day close to colleagues – you are not alone, but become part of a committed workplace where your ideas and commitment make a difference.

  • A job where we focus on making time for both work and leisure.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at:

21 44 59 19.

 Please send your application as soon as possible to Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at: jm@motilitycount.com.

title: Executive Assistant to the Secretary General (maternity cover)
description:
Are you a strategic thinker, structured and with exceptional execution and communication skills? And do you have experience with executive and strategic support to senior management and knowledge of humanitarian and global affairs? We are looking for an experienced, proactive, extrovert and solutions oriented Executive Assistant to the Secretary General of the Danish Refugee Council (DRC). You will support the Secretary General in her daily work, work closely with the DRC Executive Management Team and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

About the job

The office of the Secretary General is a small dynamic team, supporting the Secretary General, the Executive Management Team, the Board of Directors, and the Council of DRC. The office also supports DRC’s overall organisational processes and its overall strategy, provides management and administrative support to the Secretary General, and organises global staff meetings. The office works and coordinates closely with departments in headquarters as well as DRC offices across the world.

 

Your key responsibilities will include:

·         Day-to-day comprehensive executive support and advice to the Secretary General, including on external engagements, positioning and communication, in close coordination with relevant teams. Liaising and communicating clearly and professionally on behalf of the Secretary General internally in DRC and with external stakeholders.

·         Support to the Executive Management Team (EMT), including preparation of agendas and presentations, decision-making documents and minutes, follow-up to decisions, and preparation of regular bilateral meetings between the SG and EMT members, including agenda setting. 

·         Coordinating and advising on processes for preparing the Secretary General’s external engagements, including drafting and proof reading of products (briefs, talking points, presentations etc.) for the Secretary General, and ensure timely and efficient follow-ups and minutes, and feedback to relevant teams.

·         Making sure that the Secretary General receives information requiring her attention and action and managing the Secretary General’s calendar.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen ways of working through digital tools, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

·         Ensuring expense management in Microsoft Dynamics, related to SG travels, events and meetings (primary task of student assistant).

·         Ensuring legalisation of documents required across the organisation, including notarisation, apostilles, and coordination with embassies and translation services (primary task of student assistant).

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

·         A relevant master’s degree in international relations, political science or similar.

·         Excellent collaboration, analytical, organisational and communication skills, a flexible and solution-oriented attitude, and a structured and independent way of working with the ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong attention to detail and high-quality deliverables.

·         Ability to maintain overview of a broad operational and political portfolio, advise on priorities and ensure timely execution and follow-up.

·         Solid knowledge of humanitarian affairs and operations, as well as international relations and developments impacting the work of DRC.

·         Experience in interacting with many different stakeholders, including high level, ideally from diplomacy and/or external relations from a global organisation.

·         Ability to deliver high-quality analytical inputs, and to draft complex briefing materials, talking points, and political or legal reports in fast-paced, high-pressure environment is required.

·         Full professional proficiency in Danish and English. Basic knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable.

 

All employees should master DRC's core competencies:

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

An interesting workplace with excellent colleagues and plenty of scope for contribution with your own ideas. The possibility of working closely with and supporting the Secretary General and the Executive Management Team, as well as colleagues across our global organisation.

Contract length: 9 months with the possibility of extension (maternity cover)

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Start date: mid-November 2026 or the soonest hereafter

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and AC. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply. Salary will be determined based on qualifications.

Please note that you need to have the right to work in Denmark (through nationality or existing work visa) in order to be considered for this role. 

 

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English (no longer than four pages) as well as degree certificate. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 2 September 2026. We expect to conduct interviews in September.

Further information 

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Vibeke Bach Madsen, Corporate Strategic Advisor in the Secretary General’s Office: vibeke.bach.madsen@drc.ngo. We will do our best to respond to as many inquiries as possible.

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

SEO Specialist

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. Tools Experience with some of the following tools is preferred: • Google Search Console; • Google Analytics; • Ahrefs / Semrush; • Screaming Frog; • Google Keyword Planner; • PageSpeed Insights.

description:

Tööülesanded: Inimeseõpetuse õpetajana lood gümnaasiuminoortele õppimiseks keskkonna, kus on ruumi nii mõtlemiseks, küsimiseks kui ka eksimiseks.
Mentorina oled noorele kooliteel tark ja usaldusväärne täiskasvanu – aitad tal märgata oma tugevusi, teha valikuid ning tulla toime nende kohtadega, kus ta vajab rohkem tuge. Igapäevatöö juurde kuulub koostöö kolleegidega, oma aine ja õpetamise arendamine ning osalemine kooli ühistes tegemistes. Me ei eelda, et kõik õpetajad teevad kõike ühtemoodi – ootame professionaali, kes oskab oma tööd kujundada ja tahab samal ajal teistega koos õppida.

Omalt poolt pakume: Rae Gümnaasiumis saad töötada koolis, kus õpetaja ei ole ainult oma tunni andja, vaid oluline osa noore arengust ja kooli kujundavast meeskonnast.
Meie juures saad: * kaasaegse ja hästi varustatud õpikeskkonna; * võimaluse oma õpetamist ise kujundada ning uusi lahendusi proovida; * kolleegid, kellega saab arutada, katsetada ja koos õppida; * mentori rolli, mis võimaldab õppijat tundma õppida ka väljaspool oma ainetundi; * võimaluse panustada kasvava gümnaasiumi arengusse ja kujundada koos meiega seda, milline üks hea tänapäevane gümnaasium olla võiks; * professionaalse arengu võimalused ja toetuse oma töö arendamiseks. Meie jaoks on oluline, et inimene tunneks end meeskonnas vajalikuna, saaks kasutada oma professionaalsust ning tunneks, et tema tööl on päriselt mõju.

Muud nõuded: Ootame õpetajat, kes tahab ise areneda ja teisi arengus toetada, julgeb proovida ja üllatada, oskab olla järjepidev ning tunneb rõõmu õppimisest, koostööst ja õppijate saavutustest. Meie õpetaja on valmis olema õppijale ka individuaalne mentor – tark täiskasvanu, kes aitab noorel oma arengut märgata, valikuid läbi mõelda ja sihte seada.

title: Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? We offer both permanent and fixed-term full-time employment opportunities. Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in English
- Fluency in Finnish is highly valued (additional languages are an advantage)
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Eligible to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit: https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. Submit your application through the official application form, as we are unable to consider applications sent by email due to data protection reasons. The employment contract is made with Finnair, and Barona is the recruitment partner in the process. If you have any further questions, please contact finnair@barona.fi.

Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed.We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success.According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.

title: Japanese speaking Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! We are looking to strengthen our group of cabin crew employees with knowledge of Japanese language and culture to join our Helsinki base. This Japanese speaking group will be dedicated to serve our Japanese routes as well as European and domestic scheduled flights. Employment contracts will be full-time permanent. Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in Japanese and English, additional languages are an advantage
- Knowledge of Japanese culture
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid Japanese or EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Eligible to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit:https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair-japan-avoimet-tyopaikat/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. Submit your application through the official application form, as we are unable to consider applications sent by email due to data protection reasons. The employment contract is made with Finnair, and Barona is the recruitment partner in the process. If you have any further questions, please contact finnair@barona.fi.

Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed.We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success.According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.

title: CSRD Reporting Expert, (Project Manager)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Would you like to play a key role in shaping and delivering sustainability reporting in a leading Nordic retail group? We are looking for an experienced CSRD Reporting Expert to lead our CSRD reporting and reporting development projects. Position is in Tokmanni Group's Sustainability team and for a one-year parental leave replacement.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting and supporting the continuous development of reporting processes and practices. The position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality sustainability disclosures and compliance with evolving reporting requirements.

While the title includes project management responsibilities, we are primarily looking for a hands-on sustainability reporting professional. You have personally worked on CSRD reporting, collected and validated sustainability data, interpreted reporting requirements, and written report content. We are primarily looking for candidates who have hands-on experience preparing CSRD reports for listed companies, either in-house or in a consulting role. Success in this role requires both project leadership skills in cross company network and extensive hands-on experience in sustainability reporting, combined with deep practical expertise in the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and their application in corporate reporting.



Your key responsibilities

- Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting process
- Collect, analyze, validate, and manage sustainability-related data across the organization
- Prepare and develop sustainability report content in line with ESRS requirements
- Interpret sustainability reporting regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical reporting actions
- Support the update and further development of the Group's Double Materiality Assessment
- Develop reporting processes, data management practices, and reporting tools
- Produce and review reporting materials in both Finnish and English
- Coordinate and review translations between Finnish and English to ensure consistency and quality
- Work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, finance, HR, procurement, legal, marketing, business operations, and external assurance providers.



What we expect from you

- Hands-on experience preparing CSRD reporting in a listed company or as a consultant supporting listed companies
- Proven track record in sustainability data collection, data management and drafting CSRD-compliant sustainability report content
- Deep and comprehensive expertise in the ESRS standards and demonstrated ability to apply them in practice within CSRD reporting
- Strong understanding of the sustainability reporting regulatory landscape and reporting frameworks
- Excellent written communication skills and experience drafting reporting content
- Fluency in both Finnish and English, with the ability to translate and adapt content between the two languages. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an asset.
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- A structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive progress without formal authority. - Ability to start working as soon as possible.

We also value experience in double materiality assessments, reporting system development, and knowledge of the retail or consumer goods industry.



What we offer

We offer you a unique opportunity to work at the heart of sustainability reporting in one of Finland's leading retail groups. You will have a visible and impactful role, working with a broad range of stakeholders and contributing to the development of Tokmanni Group's sustainability reporting and reporting capabilities.

You will join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration is valued and success is achieved together. We offer a flexible hybrid working model that combines office and remote working, enabling both effective teamwork and focused individual work.

In addition, we provide a competitive package of employee benefits, including ePassi, staff discounts, and a wide range of partner benefits.



Application instructions and further information

The position is a fixed-term parental leave replacement for one year. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. The weekly working hours are 37.5 h/week. The primary workplace is Tokmanni Group's Head Office in Mäntsälä, Finland, and the role follows the Group's hybrid working model. Occasional travel within the Group may be required.

Please submit your application, CV, and salary expectation as soon as possible or at the latest on August 28th. We will review applications during the application period and fill the position immediately once the right candidate is found.

Further information will be given by Kaisa Matsson, Group Head of Sustainability tel. 040 6734948 or by email kaisa.mattson@tokmanni.fi. Please call on Wednesday Aug 19th 9-12 and Friday Aug 21st 10-13.

title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri

title: Accountant, Espoo
description:
About the role

In this role, you will support our client with general ledger accounting and month-end closing activities. You will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and clarity of financial data, while actively developing and automating processes in close collaboration with other team members. Our client is best suited for someone with a genuine "hunger for success", a drive to push things forward, and the ability to thrive in a changing environment while seeing change as an opportunity.

You are offered
- The opportunity to work in a global, growing organization
- The opportunity to make an impact and bring the value of your expertise to the organization as it matures around you
- The opportunity to influence day-to-day operations and develop them with your own ideas
- Partial remote work (2 days/week) and an Epassi lunch benefit

Work tasks

The role includes general ledger accounting tasks such as postings, reconciliations, and month-end closing activities. You will work closely with the team to ensure the smoothness and accuracy of financial processes.
- Maintaining the general ledger
- Preparing journal entries
- Month-end closing activities
- Balance sheet reconciliations
- Recording payments from bank statements
- Creating and developing documentation
- Communicating within the organization when investigating accounting transactions

We are looking for

- A relevant higher education degree in finance or accounting, preferably with a focus on accounting
- Strong practical skills and work experience in general ledger activities, including reconciliations, month-end closing, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and a solid understanding of accounting principles
- Demonstrated experience in streamlining tasks or automating workflows, along with a strong interest in leveraging AI tools in daily financial operations
- An ambitious and self-driven mindset with the tenacity to take ownership and push initiatives across the finish line
- Strong communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English
- Ability to navigate a changing organization and adapt to a rapidly evolving environment
- A precise, detail-oriented, and quality-driven working approach

It is meritorious if you have
- Experience with Netsuite ERP system

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Change oriented
- Excellent collaborator and communicator
- Organized and detail-oriented

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Uinninvalvoja/uimaopettaja
description:
Vetelin liikuntakeskuksessa ja uimahallilla liikutetaan paljon ihmisiä ja siten siellä tehdään merkityksellistä hyvinvointityötä. Etsimme joukkoomme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen uinninvalvoja/uimaopettajaa, joka työskentelee asiakaspalveluhenkisellä, innostavalla ja kehittävällä työotteella. Tehtävä täytetään 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Viikkotyöaika on 38,25 h / vk. Työhön sisältyy päivä- ja iltatyötä sekä mahdollisesti myös viikonlopputyötä.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu uinninvalvonnan ja uimaopetuksen perustehtävien lisäksi vesijumppien ja mahdollisesti myös muiden liikuntaryhmien ohjaaminen, viestintä ja markkinointi, tapahtumien suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen, toiminnan organisointi, tilavarausjärjestelmän käyttö ja laskutus sekä liikuntakeskus- ja uimahallitoiminnan suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen osallistuminen. Työn menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, positiivisuutta, aktiivisuutta, organisointitaitoa sekä vastuullisuutta ja huolellisuutta. Myös perustietotekniset taidot ovat tarpeelliset.

Uinninvalvoja/uimaopettajan tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on liikunta-alan koulutus tai muu alalle soveltuva koulutus sekä lisäksi katsomme eduksi SUH:n uinninvalvojan ja/tai uimaopettajan koulutuksen. Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää uimataitoa ja uinninvalvojan testiuinti tullaan suorittamaan todennäköisesti keväällä 2027. Eduksi katsomme ensiapukoulutuksen ja kokemuksen uinninvalvonnasta/uimaopetustyöstä/ryhmien ohjaamisesta.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2315,11 € ja lisäksi tulevat mahdolliset työkokemuslisät. Koeaika on kuusi (6) kuukautta. Valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote 30 vuorokauden sisällä työn aloittamisesta.

Jatkamme hakuaikaa ja aikaisemmin tehtävään hakeneet huomioidaan. Hakuaika päättyy 6.9.2026 ja hakemukset toimitetaan tähän päivämäärään mennessä sähköisesti Kuntarekryn kautta. Hakemukseen tulee liittää CV ja todistus koulutuksesta. Valinnasta tiedotamme kaikkia hakijoita Kuntarekryn kautta sähköisesti.

Olemme arvostettu työnantaja, kehitämme aktiivisesti toimintojamme ja edistämme kuntalaisten hyvinvointia eri tavoin. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme maksuttoman uimahallin ja kuntosalin käytön sekä 100 euron Epassi-edun. Olemme savuton kunta.

title: Research specialist (Grant writer)

- Has a proven track record of developing competitive research proposals, particularly for EU funding instruments.
- Has excellent communication skills in English; good knowledge of Swedish and/or Finnish is considered an asset.
- Has strong organisational skills, including the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
- Has good knowledge of responsible research practices.

Employment

Starting from October 12, 2026, or as agreed.

Salary in accordance with the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences and Novia's internal guidelines. The position includes a sixmonth probationary period.

Location

As agreed: Vaasa, Turku, or Jakobstad.

Further Information

Contact Head of Research Services Otto Långvik, mobile +358 50 527 8167, firstname.lastname@novia.fi

Application

title: Sales Representative – Saariselkä, Lapland
description:
**Kuukkeli & Lapponia Tours are looking for a Travel Sales Representative to strengthen our growing sales team in Saariselkä.**

We are looking for an active, self-driven and customer-oriented sales professional to work with our wide range of tourism services. In this role, you will sell and build travel packages that may include accommodation, activities, transportation, restaurant services and other Lapland travel services.

Our customers include both domestic and international individual travellers, groups, companies, travel agencies and tour operators.

This position is suitable for someone who enjoys sales, working with people and varied working days, and who is able to independently manage customer relationships and sales processes from enquiry to completion.

**Your responsibilities may include, among other things:**

- selling accommodation, activities, transportation and other tourism services

- active customer acquisition and identifying new sales opportunities

- handling individual, group and corporate bookings

- preparing quotations and complete travel packages

- communicating with domestic and international customers

- serving B2B customers, tour operators and travel agencies

- acquiring new customers and developing existing customer relationships

- handling incoming sales enquiries and quotation requests by email and phone

- creating and updating reservations in our booking systems

- working closely with reception, activities, transportation and other operational teams

- sales-related maintenance of products, pricing and availability

- participating in the development of our sales operations and tourism services when needed


The exact responsibilities can also be adjusted based on the selected candidates previous experience and strengths.

**What do we expect from you?**

We are looking for someone with a strong commercial mindset, a results-oriented attitude and previous experience in tourism, sales or another similar commercial role. This position is not intended for someone completely at the beginning of their career. We expect you to be ready to take responsibility for customer relationships, sales and quotation processes with a fairly independent approach.

**We hope you have:**

- a strong customer service and sales mindset

- **fluent English skills**

- good Finnish language skills

- strong written and verbal communication skills

- the ability to work independently and take responsibility for your own tasks

- an organised and detail-oriented way of working

- the ability to manage several customer relationships and sales processes simultaneously

- a proactive and active approach to sales

- good general IT skills


Previous experience in tourism sales, hotel reservations, group sales, B2B sales or working with tour operators is considered an advantage.

Experience with tourism booking and sales systems is beneficial, but the most important thing is the ability to learn new systems quickly. We provide comprehensive training in our products and the systems we use.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

**What do we offer?**

We offer a responsible and diverse sales position in a rapidly growing tourism business in Saariselkä.

**You will get:**

- a varied role working with accommodation, activities and other tourism services

- the opportunity to work with both B2C and B2B customers

- comprehensive training in our products and systems

- an international working environment

- the opportunity to shape your role based on your experience and skills

- the possibility to develop professionally and take on more responsibility as the organisation grows

- a practical and fast-developing working environment

- the opportunity for long-term employment with us


**Accommodation can be arranged if needed.** Depending on availability, accommodation options may include private rooms, shared accommodation, as well as smaller and larger apartments.

**Employment and starting date**

We are looking for long-term sales professionals who want to become part of our growing team and develop with our tourism business beyond a single season.

The position is full-time and permanent. The exact starting date can be agreed with the selected candidate, but we expect the successful candidate to start no later than the beginning of November 2026.

At least during the initial stages of employment, the work will primarily take place on-site at our offices in Saariselkä or Ivalo. This allows for effective onboarding, familiarisation with our products and services, and close cooperation with the rest of the team.

As the employment progresses, the possibility of partial remote work can also be discussed, depending on the role, experience and practical arrangements.

title: Safari Guide – Winter Season 2026–2027, Saariselkä
description:
**Kuukkeli & Lapponia Tours are looking for Safari Guides for the winter season 2026–2027 in Saariselkä.**

We are looking for energetic, service-minded guides to join our growing team in Saariselkä. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, loves the nature of Lapland, and wants to help create unforgettable experiences for our international guests.

**The position is seasonal and runs from around the turn of November–December until the end of March 2027.**

**Your duties may include, among other things:**

- customer service and guiding on reindeer or husky excursions

- leading snowshoeing tours and other winter activities

- guiding snowmobile safaris

- guiding Northern Lights tours

- guest transfers and pick-ups when needed

- preparing and maintaining equipment and assisting with the practical arrangements of excursions

- ensuring guest safety and providing an excellent customer experience


The working days are varied and, as is typical in the tourism industry, shifts may also take place in the evenings and on weekends.

**What do we expect from you?**

Above all, we are looking for people with a positive attitude who are able to work independently while also being good team players.

**We hope you have:**

- a strong customer service attitude

- **fluent English skills**

- a valid driving licence

- the ability to act responsibly and calmly in different situations

- flexibility regarding working hours

- an interest in Lapland, nature and tourism

- willingness to work outdoors also in cold winter conditions


Previous experience in guiding, tourism or snowmobile driving is considered an advantage, but you do not need to know everything in advance. We provide training and familiarisation with our activities and products before you begin working independently.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

**What do we offer?**

We offer a diverse and varied position in one of Finlands best-known winter tourism destinations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our rapidly growing activity business.

**You will get:**

- diverse and varied work duties

- comprehensive training and onboarding

- an international working environment

- the opportunity to work in the beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- a friendly and practical working community

- the possibility to continue working with us in future seasons


**Accommodation can be arranged if needed.** Depending on availability, accommodation options may include private rooms, shared accommodation, as well as smaller and larger apartments.

title: Software Developer (Flutter & Digital Services)
description:
**Help shape the future of intelligent lighting.**

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our team and help build the next generation of Casambi's digital services.

Your initial focus will be on a new licence activation project and the systems that manage customer licences, and access to products and services. As the project evolves, you'll have opportunities to work across multiple products and services, contributing both to new development and the continuous improvement of existing solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building polished user experiences while also understanding how complete systems work behind the scenes. Although the primary focus is mobile and web development using Flutter, you'll be expected to understand the entire solution and confidently read and understand backend code when needed.

Most importantly, we're looking for a developer who enjoys learning, embraces new technologies, and actively uses AI as part of their daily development workflow.

**What you'll do**

Develop mobile and web applications using Flutter

Build solutions that support product licensing, customer onboarding, and access to digital services

Collaborate with backend, cloud, product, and business teams to deliver complete solutions

Understand, debug, and occasionally contribute to .NET C# backend services

Participate in technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and testing

Use AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, quality, and learning

Learn new technologies, business processes, and customer requirements as products evolve

Contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept and implementation to release and customer adoption

Maintain solutions after launch and develop new capabilities based on business needs and customer feedback

Work across multiple products and projects as priorities and opportunities evolve

**What we're looking for**

**Essential**

5+ years of professional software development experience

Strong software engineering fundamentals and problem-solving skills

Experience developing modern mobile and/or web applications

Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and business domains

Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality

Understanding of full-stack application architecture

Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

Strong communication skills

**Highly appreciated**

Experience with Flutter

Experience with .NET and C#

Experience with cloud-based services and APIs

Experience with automated testing and CI/CD practices Experience shipping new products or major product capabilities to customers

Product-oriented mindset and customer focus

**Ways of working**

We support flexible and remote working. At the same time, we believe that some of the best collaboration happens face-to-face.

We expect team members to be able to visit our office approximately once per month and occasionally spend several consecutive days on-site for team events, workshops, planning sessions, or other collaborative activities.

**Why join us?**

You'll work on business-critical solutions that directly impact how customers activate, access, and manage Casambi products and services. This role offers a unique combination of modern application development, business process understanding, and real product ownership.

We value engineers who care not only about writing code, but also about delivering successful products that solve real customer problems and continue to provide value long after their initial release.

**We are looking for product builders, not just feature developers. Candidates with experience bringing new products or major product capabilities from idea to customer deployment are particularly encouraged to apply.**

_\* Applications are processed with the help of AI (for example, to detect and summarize whether criteria are met), but the final assessment is always made by a human._

title: Software Developer (Cloud Gateway & Edge Systems)
description:
**Build the bridge between devices, cloud services, and customers.**

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join the Cloud Gateway team and help shape the future of Casambi's gateway platform.

Your primary focus will be our Cloud Gateway product, which connects physical devices to cloud services, enables secure remote management, and supports large scale deployments in customer environments. The role spans multiple technology layers, from Linux-based edge devices to cloud services, backend systems, and operational tooling.

While the gateway platform will be your main area of responsibility, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to other backend services and products as our technology landscape evolves, including several .NET-based systems and services.

We're looking for a developer who thrives in technically challenging environments, enjoys learning continuously, and actively leverages AI tools to become more productive and effective.

**What you'll do**

Design, develop, and maintain software for cloud-connected gateway products

Work across edge devices, operating systems, cloud services, backend systems, and operational tooling

Contribute to the architecture, security, reliability, and maintainability of gateway solutions

Develop and improve remote device management, connectivity, and software update capabilities

Investigate and solve complex issues across device, network, cloud, and application layers

Collaborate with hardware, cloud, backend, and product teams

Use AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, quality, troubleshooting, and learning

Participate throughout the full product lifecycle, from concept and development to deployment, operation, and continuous improvement

Maintain solutions after launch and develop new capabilities based on business needs and customer feedback

Contribute to multiple products and services as priorities and opportunities evolve

**What we're looking for**

**Essential**

5+ years of professional software development experience

Strong software engineering, debugging, and problem-solving skills

Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and business domains

Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality

Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently

Interest in developing reliable, scalable, and secure systems

Strong communication and collaboration skills

**Highly appreciated**

Experience developing software for Linux-based systems, servers, or edge devices

Experience building secure, reliable, and maintainable distributed systems

Experience with device connectivity, remote management, or over-the-air (OTA) software update solutions

Experience with cloud platforms, backend services, or modern communication protocols such as MQTT and WebSockets

Experience with technologies such as .NET/C#, Ubuntu Core, containers, or Bluetooth

Understanding of cybersecurity and secure software development practices

Experience shipping new products or major product capabilities to customers

We support flexible and remote working. At the same time, we believe that some of the best collaboration happens face-to-face.

We expect team members to be able to visit our office approximately once per month and occasionally spend several consecutive days on-site for team events, workshops, planning sessions, or other collaborative activities.

**Why join us?**

You'll work on a product that spans edge devices, operating systems, cloud infrastructure, security, connectivity, remote management, and software updates throughout the entire device lifecycle.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging real-world problems while owning solutions that operate in production environments and support large-scale customer deployments. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, practical innovation, and the effective use of AI to build better products faster.

We value engineers who care not only about writing code, but also about delivering successful products that solve real customer problems and continue to provide value long after their initial release.

**We are looking for product builders, not just feature developers. Candidates with experience bringing new products or major product capabilities from idea to customer deployment are particularly encouraged to apply.**

_\* Applications are processed with the help of AI (for example, to detect and summarize whether criteria are met), but the final assessment is always made by a human._

title: Mechanical Engineer, Evac, Espoo
description:
About the role

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will work closely with hands-on designing activities and create 3D models, drawings and technical documentations to make sure that deliverables meet technical, quality, and schedule requirements.

In addition to that, you will work with data management and ensure that all the components are backed by complete background data, including for example material specs, voltage requirements, and precise item numbers. Position also requires a close cooperation with different stakeholders such as project management, product management, and other engineering disciplines.

We are looking for a person who has excellent technical knowledge and understanding with engineering data quality and integrity management. As a person, we are looking for an analytical problem-solver who is able to cooperate smoothly with different stakeholders.

You are offered
- Possibility to work with varied and diverse tasks and projects
- Highly interesting role in a global setting
- Opportunity to work towards zero-waste future in a stable and growing company
- Possibility to work with a team full of professionals and develop your skills
- Flexible ways of working from the office and remotely

Work tasks
- Performing mechanical engineering and design activities
- Creating and maintaining 3D models, drawings, and technical documentation
- Ensuring engineering data quality and integrity
- Participating in design reviews and continuous improvement activities
- Collaborating with different stakeholders, such as project management, product management and other engineering disciplines

We are looking for

- Relevant study background in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent engineering area
- Experience in mechanical engineering and designing activities
- Experience with engineering documentation and technical specifications
- Experience working with Creo and PDM systems
- Systematic, problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail in designing and data management
- Strong cooperation skills with different stakeholders
- Fluency in English

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Hitsaaja-asentaja Lohjalle
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Jamenet Oy:lle hitsaaja-asentajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Lohjalle. **Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja monipuolista hitsaaja-asentajaa, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työtehtävissä** teollisuuden kunnossapidon parissa ja haluaa päästä tekemään **koneiden ja laitteiden hitsaus-, korjaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä konepajaympäristössä.**

Korjattavana ja huollettavana on monenlaisia teollisuuden koneita ja laitteita, kuten stabilointikoneita, kahmareita ja muita työkoneita. Työt vaihtelevat pienemmistä komponenteista hyvinkin raskaisiin koneisiin. Kokemus esimerkiksi myös pumppujen parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi. **Toivommekin, että sinulla on kokemusta erilaisista teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävistä ja hitsausosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla.** Luokkahitsari yrityksestä löytyy valmiina, joten luokkia sinulla ei tarvitse olla suoritettuna.

Jamenet Oy toimii Lohjan Muijalan teollisuusalueella yhdessä Sideko Oy:n kanssa. Yrityksessä tehdään monipuolisesti koneistus-, hitsaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä. Työyhteisö on huumorintajuinen noin 15 hengen pieni ja mutkaton tiimi, jossa työntekijät ovat viihtyneet pitkään.

**Työt alkavat nopealla aikataululla heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.** Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin ja aloitus on liukuvasti klo 6-7 välillä. Työpäivän pituus on 8,5h sisältäen palkattoman 30 minuutin ruokatauon. Onhan sinulla oma auto liikkumista varten.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

**Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat tilanteen mukaan. Pääset tekemään muun muassa**

- Asennushitsausta

- Korjaushitsausta

- Koneiden ja laitteiden korjaus- ja asennustöitä

- Pajalle tuotujen koneiden ja komponenttien kunnostamista

- Teollisuuden kunnossapitotöitä

- Koneenosien ja rakenteiden korjaamista ja kokoonpanoa


Toivomme sinulta:

- Aiempaa työkokemusta hitsauksesta sekä teollisuuden kunnossapidon asennus- ja korjaustehtävistä

- MIG/MAG-hitsauksen osaamista

- Kokemusta asennus- ja korjaustöistä

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia konepaja- ja kunnossapitotöitä

- Oma-aloitteista ja huolellista työotetta

- Halua oppia uutta

- Hyvää suomen kielen osaamista

- Omaa autoa


**Kone- ja tuotantotekniikan koulutus on eduksi, mutta käytännön työkokemus on tärkeintä.**

**Tulityö- ja työturvallisuuskorteista ei ole haittaa, mutta niitä ei edellytetä oman verstaan työtehtävissä. Myöskään erillisiä luokkahitsauspätevyyksiä ei vaadita – tärkeintä on, että hitsaus onnistuu käytännössä.**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Pitkäaikaisen työpaikan monipuolisten teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävien parissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja oppia uusia työmenetelmiä

- Työvaatteet ja henkilönsuojaimet työnantajan puolesta

- Palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, noin 14–24 €/h, Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimukseen pohjautuen.


Laita hakemuksesi tulemaan pikaisesti järjestelmän kautta ja lähde mukaan hitsauksen ja asennuksen pariin Jamenetin porukaan! Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tarvittaessa voit kysyä lisätietoa sähköpostitse Timanttien Hannalta hanna.kiertonen@timantti.net.

_Timantti Henkilöstöpalvelut auttaa osaajia löytämään työn, joka sopii heidän taitoihinsa ja tavoitteisiinsa. Työllistämme työntekijöitä eri toimialojen monipuolisiin tehtäviin – niin määräaikaisiin, vakituisiin kuin projektiluonteisiinkin työsuhteisiin. Meille työntekijä ei ole vain resurssi, vaan tärkeä osa Timantin yhteisöä. Tarjoamme joustavia ratkaisuja, uusia mahdollisuuksia ja tukea työurasi eri vaiheissa – jotta sinä voit keskittyä siihen, missä olet parhaimmillasi._

title: Geospatial AI Developer
description:
**Joensuu preferred | Hybrid/remote within Finland possible | Full-time or part-time alongside studies**

Forest Key is looking for a **Geospatial AI Developer** to strengthen our capacity to develop AI-based solutions for forestry.

We work at the intersection of forestry, remote sensing, GIS, data analytics and software development. The role supports our growing international project portfolio and the development of customer-specific digital solutions for operational forestry.

**Your role**

Your main task will be to develop **AI-based remote-sensing and GIS data-processing solutions for forestry applications**.

The emphasis is on technical development, analytical workflows and robust code rather than polished user-interface development.

Your work may include:

- developing AI and machine-learning solutions using remote-sensing, GIS and forestry data;

- processing and analysing satellite, LiDAR, drone and other large geospatial datasets;

- developing Python-based workflows and maintainable processing pipelines;

- implementing solutions in cloud or other scalable computing environments; and

- supporting technical demonstrations, customer discussions and solution development.


**What we are looking for**

You do not need to be a senior specialist. We are interested in someone with relevant practical experience, strong technical skills and the ability to develop toward independent responsibility.

We expect:

- strong **Python** programming skills;

- practical experience with **AI or machine learning**;

- experience with **remote sensing, GIS and LiDAR or point-cloud data**;

- relevant experience or understanding of the **forest sector and forestry applications**;

- ability to develop analytical work into repeatable and maintainable technical solutions;

- ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems; and

- professional proficiency in **English**.


Professional proficiency in Finnish is a clear advantage.

**Additional advantages**

Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial:

- deep learning, computer vision or advanced point-cloud processing;

- Azure or another cloud environment, Docker or related deployment technologies;

- spatial databases or geospatial software development;

- technical customer meetings and demonstrations; or

- other languages relevant to international work.


Occasional participation in customer visits, conferences or international project activities may be possible.

**What we offer**

You will join a small and growing team where your work has a direct influence on the technical solutions we develop.

The role offers opportunities to:

- work on real operational forestry problems;

- combine AI, software development, GIS and remote sensing;

- participate in Finnish and international projects;

- contribute to new digital forestry services; and

- take increasing technical responsibility as your experience develops.


**Location and working arrangements**

Our office is in **Joensuu**, and the possibility to work regularly from Joensuu is a clear advantage. Hybrid and remote working arrangements within Finland are possible.

The position can be **full-time**, but working hours can also be adapted for a suitable candidate who is completing studies.

For administrative reasons, we are currently looking for a person who is resident and able to work in Finland.

**How to apply**

Please send your **CV** and a short description of:

- your relevant experience;

- the types of AI, remote-sensing, GIS or software-development work you have done; and

- why you would like to join Forest Key.


Send your application to:

Alain Minguet Director of International Business +358 44 9025317 alain@forestkey.eu

For questions about the position, you may contact Alain by email or by phone during the following available periods:

- 28 August, 09:00–11:00

- 2 September, 14:00–17:00

- 4 September, 09:00–11:00


**Application deadline: 10 September 2026.**

We may fill the position before the application deadline if we find a suitable candidate, so early applications are encouraged.

title: CNC-koneistaja/ manuaalikoneistaja
description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Jamenet Oy:lle kahta CNC-koneistajaa / manuaalikoneistajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Lohjalle. Etsimämme henkilöt ovat osaavia, itsenäiseen työhön kykeneviä ja motivoituneita koneistajia, jotka haluavat päästä tekemään monipuolista konepajatyötä. Asiakasyrityksessämme on koneet valmiina ja odottavatkin juuri sinua!

Työstettävät kappaleet vaihtelevat pienistä kappaleista suuriin kokonaisuuksiin. Sorvattavissa kappaleissa halkaisija voi olla jopa noin 1800 mm ja pituutta useita metrejä. Jos pidät isojen kappaleiden tekemisestä, niitä on tarjolla – mutta myös pienempää koneistusta riittää. **Työtehtävät voidaankin räätälöidä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan - työ on vaihtelevaa ja Jamenet kouluttaa mielellään uusien asioiden pariin.**

Konekantaan kuuluu muun muassa Mazakin sorveja ja työstökeskuksia, lisäksi käytössä on Okumaa ja Union-aarpora sekä manuaalikoneita. Mazakin ohjelmointi voidaan opettaa työn ohessa, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Hyötyä kuitenkin on, että on aiemmin tehnyt ohjelmointia. Jonkin verran käytetään myös Fanukin järjestelmiä.

Jamenet Oy toimii Lohjan Muijalan teollisuusalueella yhdessä Sideko Oy:n kanssa. Yrityksessä tehdään monipuolisesti koneistus-, hitsaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä. Työyhteisö on huumorintajuinen noin 15 hengen pieni ja mutkaton tiimi, jossa työntekijät ovat viihtyneet pitkään.

**Työt alkavat nopealla aikataululla heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.** Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin ja aloitus on liukuvasti klo 6-7 välillä. Työpäivän pituus on 8,5h sisältäen palkattoman 30 minuutin ruokatauon. Onhan sinulla oma auto liikkumista varten.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

**Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja niitä voidaan muokata osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Ensisijaisesti haemme CNC-koneistajaa, mutta myös kokenut manuaalikoneistaja on tervetullut hakemaan – CNC-koneistuksen osaamista voidaan tarvittaessa opettaa työn ohessa.**

- CNC-koneiden käyttö ja asetusten tekeminen

- erilaisten kappaleiden valmistus yksittäiskappaleista sarjatuotantoon

- manuaalikoneistus

- ohjelmointi ja ohjelmien muokkaaminen

- mittaukset ja laadunvalvonta

- teknisten piirustusten lukeminen

- erikokoisten ja erilaisten kappaleiden valmistus


Toivomme sinulta:

**Tähän tehtävään noin viiden vuoden työkokemus on hyvä lähtökohta, mutta myös vähemmän kokemusta omaava, motivoitunut ja nopeasti oppiva tekijä voi sopia tehtävään erinomaisesti!**

- CNC- ja/tai manuaalikoneistuksen osaamista

- Kone- ja tuotantotekniikan perustutkinto on etu, mutta työkokemus ja osaaminen ovat etusijalla

- Teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- Halua oppia uusia koneita ja työmenetelmiä

- Luotettavuutta ja hyvää työmotivaatiota

- Halua sitoutua pitkäaikaisesti työtehtäviin

- Hyvää suomen kielen osaamista

- Omaa autoa


Tarjoamme:

- Pitkäaikaisen työpaikan monipuolisen koneistuksen parissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja oppia uusia työmenetelmiä

- Työtehtäviä oman osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan

- Työvaatteet ja henkilönsuojaimet työnantajan puolesta

- Palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, noin 14–24 €/h, Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimukseen pohjautuen.
