title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Maintenance technician
description:
We are looking for a Maintenance Mechanic / Maintenance Technician or a mechanically skilled and hands-on person to join our maintenance team in a meat processing plant.

The role involves preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs and general technical support for production machinery and equipment. The employee will work closely with production staff to ensure reliable operation of equipment and minimize production downtime.

Main responsibilities:
Preventive maintenance and servicing of production machinery
Troubleshooting and repairing mechanical faults
Assisting with installation, adjustment and improvement of equipment
Responding to breakdowns and minimizing production downtime
General maintenance work throughout the production facility

Mechanical background or strong practical/mechanical skills
Experience in industrial maintenance, food production or similar environments is an advantage
Experience with food processing and packaging equipment from manufacturers such as Weber, MULTIVAC, K+G Wetter and VEMAG is a strong advantage
Experience with maintenance of slaughter line equipment is an advantage
Ability to troubleshoot mechanical and technical problems independently
Electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic experience is an advantage
Good spoken and written English is required
Reliable, organized and able to work both independently and as part of a team

We offer:
Salary negotiable based on experience, qualifications and education , according to collective agreements
Meals provided during working hours

A varied technical role in an active food production environment
Opportunity to work with a wide range of modern food processing and packaging machinery

title: Technical Director
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.

•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level

Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.

End-to-End Operations Management of 3PL Warehouse • Responsible for the daily end-to-end operations management of a single warehouse in Europe under the 3PL model, covering inbound, outbound, and inventory management; ensure inventory accuracy, inbound/outbound timeliness, and stable order fulfillment quality. • Coordinate the standardized execution and continuous optimization of core operational processes, including inbound quality inspection, put-away and storage, picking and packing, and outbound shipping. • Monitor daily/weekly/monthly operational data of 3PL service providers, promptly identify abnormalities, and drive corrective actions to closure. 3PL Service Provider Coordination and SLA Management • Serve as the key point of contact with 3PL service providers, responsible for daily operational communication, issue escalation, and relationship management. • Develop and drive the implementation of SLA metrics for 3PL service providers, including timeliness, accuracy, damage rate, and capacity flexibility; conduct regular reviews and performance evaluations. • Lead operational quality audits of 3PL providers, identify service gaps, and drive improvements in areas such as labor, equipment, and system integration. Labor and Productivity Management • Conduct workforce demand planning based on business forecasts and monitor deviations between actual attendance and planned staffing. • Address unexcused absenteeism, improve employee retention, analyze fluctuations in labor costs through data, and propose improvement plans. Inventory and Quality Control Management • Manage differentiated inbound processes for goods from multiple channels to ensure delivery quality and timeliness. • Responsible for storage planning and implementation of operational standards for different product categories, including general merchandise, bulky items, high-value goods, and shelf-life-sensitive products. • Drive closed-loop returns management, return-to-supplier optimization, and compliant labeling for special product categories. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Collaborate with Planning/S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, and other departments to ensure efficient coordination among business forecasting, workforce preparation, and fulfillment delivery. • Respond quickly to capacity bottlenecks by coordinating urgent recruitment or temporary resource allocation across warehouses.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL LOGISTICA, TRASPORTO MERCI E SPEDIZIONE (CNEL I100). Le opzioni di turno disponibili saranno confermate successivamente nel corso del processo di candidatura. Luogo di lavoro: Via di Valle Caia X, 00040 Ardea (Roma) Principali attività: - Ricevere, controllare, ordinare e riporre tutti i prodotti. - Raccogliere, imballare e spedire tutti gli ordini. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

title: Orthodontiste (H/F)
description:
Un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire à Rogliano, en Italie, cherche son nouvel orthophoniste H/F pour un CDI.

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages
- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site
- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Le petit truc en plus
Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

Orthophoniste diplômé(e), inscrit auprès de la région de Calabre pour l'exercice. Un accompagnement complet sera assuré durant les démarches, sous réserve de la fourniture des documents requis.

Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Mirano organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO per la figura di: Operatore/Operatrice di Cucina Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 80 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: Organizzazione e funzionamento delle mense scolastiche e ospedaliere, tavole calde e self-service Struttura della mensa, principali mansioni e ruolo dell'addetto mensa Allestimento e pulizia degli ambienti, delle attrezzature e degli utensili di cucina nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Pulizia, sanificazione, disinfezione e disinfestazione igienico sanitaria di ambienti, attrezzature e utensili da cucina Operare la preparazione e somministrazione dei piatti nel rispetto delle norme HACCP Scodellamento, sporzionamento e gestione della sala Le muffe, i funghi e i lieviti: gli ambienti favorenti e processi di evitamento e prevenzione Controllare lo stato di conservazione delle materie prime e dei semilavorati alimentari stoccati Identificare ed utilizzare i materiali e le confezioni più indicate per proteggere gli alimenti da contaminazioni di tipo chimico e fisico, allungarne la conservazione e trasmettere le informazioni sul prodotto Tipologie di imballo e caratteristiche di utilizzo per il settore alimentare e celle frigorifere Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 80 e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso Confcommercio del Miranese -Via Firenze 12, 30035 - Mirano (VE). Per ogni ora di frequenza verrà riconosciuta un'indennità di frequenza, previa partecipazione ad almeno il 70% del Monte ore totale. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. title: paleontologo/paleontologa
description: Crea una forza lavoro motivata. Raggiungi i tuoi obiettivi di vita. Noi di Gi Group Holding vogliamo rendere il mondo del lavoro un luogo più sostenibile e piacevole per tutti. Dalle risorse umane alla finanza, il nostro team è composto da persone di talento, con competenze diverse, che si uniscono per trasformare il settore del reclutamento e migliorare la vita delle persone. Unisciti a noi e potrai godere della libertà, del supporto e delle opportunità che derivano dall'essere parte di un'azienda globale. Siamo alla ricerca di una figura: Global Business Model Development Intern In qualità di tirocinante, avrai l'opportunità di supportare il team Global Temp&Perm e le Countries. Lavorerai in un dipartimento internazionale con un forte focus sullo sviluppo strategico del business. Il tuo ruolo: In qualità di Global Business Model Development Intern, imparerai a: Svolgere in autonomia e in affiancamento le attività assegnate relative alla T&P Practice nei diversi progetti core Partecipare attivamente alle riunioni con i team dei Paesi Gi Group e con le Funzioni Global interne, imparando a gestire con efficacia i follow-up dei meeting Supportare la preparazione di presentazioni PowerPoint e di altre soluzioni grafiche Effettuare analisi Excel strutturate a supporto del team T&P e del business Contribuire alla crescita di iniziative di community building, preparando contenuti dedicati e garantendo comunicazioni regolari Supportare la realizzazione di iniziative di knowledge building e condivisione delle best practice rivolte a tutta l'organizzazione T&P nei diversi Paesi del Gruppo Sviluppare la presenza della practice nell'intranet del Gruppo, supportando la revisione e l'arricchimento della pagina della Global T&P Practice Requisiti: Studente o neo laureato, preferibilmente in discipline economiche o management Inglese fluente, sia parlato sia scritto Buona conoscenza di MS Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint Approccio analitico e predisposizione a comprendere un set di dati e sintetizzarne i concetti principali in modo chiaro Ottime capacità comunicative, precisione organizzativa e proattività Cosa possiamo offrirti: - Tirocinio curriculare o extracurriculare, della durata di 6 mesi full-time (dal lunedì al venerdì, 9:00/18:00) - Rimborso spese di 750 euro lordi Luogo di lavoro: Milano (zona Stazione Centrale) - modalità ibrida La nostra realtà in rapida evoluzione offre l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un team dedicato e talentuoso, che condivide uno scopo comune e lavora insieme per generare un impatto positivo. Unendoti a noi, troverai un ambiente supportivo e aperto, in cui potrai imparare a crescere e portare al lavoro la tua autenticità. Avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con persone di diversi Paesi, mettere in discussione il modo in cui facciamo le cose e trasformare le tue idee in azioni. Ti offriremo numerose opportunità di sviluppo per migliorare le tue competenze e crescere sia a livello personale sia professionale. Questo è un momento entusiasmante per entrare a far parte della nostra azienda: candidati ora e fai il primo passo per cambiare in meglio la vita delle persone, inclusa la tua. title: coordinatore di saldatura/coordinatrice di saldatura
description: TI PIACEREBBE LAVORARE IN UN'AZIENDA LEADER NEL MERCATO DELLA PROGETTAZIONE E PRODUZIONE di recipienti a pressione e componenti per la refrigerazione e il condizionamento (HVAC&R)? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Gi Group SpA in collaborazione con FRIGOMEC SPA di Legnago (VR) ricerca: OPERAIO/A SETTORE METALMECCANICO Si tratta di un inserimento - dopo un percorso di on boarding per acquisire competenze specifiche e per poter lavorare con prodotti di qualità, grazie alla capacità produttiva in costante crescita - all'interno del reparto produttivo e avrai l'opportunità di sperimentarti in plurime attività. Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Saldatura manuale o su impianti robotizzati di saldatura per recipienti a pressione e componenti per la refrigerazione e il condizionamento (HVAC&R) - serbatoi, ricevitori di liquido e separatori. Utilizzo di diverse tipologie di saldatura (MIG, MAG, Filo, TIG) Ti riconosci in queste competenze e caratteristiche? Disponibilità al lavoro su giornata e 2 turni; Buona manualità; Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio; Propensione all'ascolto, all'apprendimento e proattività; Capacità di comunicazione e lavoro in team; Forte attenzione per gli aspetti di sicurezza Problem solving e capacità di adattamento. Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Il percorso GRATUITO con copertura delle spese di residenzialità, della durata di 200 ore, che si terrà presso l'ISTITUTO ITALIANO DI SALDATURA - Via Tavoni, 2 presso Collegio Salesiano 'Astori' 31021, Mogliano Veneto (TV) - a partire dal 28 Settembre 2026, sarà strutturato attraverso l'erogazione di lezioni sui seguenti temi: Struttura del giunto saldatura; difetti in saldatura; Processi di saldatura (135/136/138/121/141); indicazione e simbologia delle saldature nei disegni; processi di saldatura: Filo continuo sotto protezione gassosa (MIG/MAG/FCAW-135/136/138); Saldatura ad elettrodo Infusibile (TIG-141), Saldatura ad arco sommerso (SAW-121); materiali: acciai al carbonio e moduli teorici legati alla Salute e Sicurezza, Diritti e doveri dei Lavoratori. È previsto al superamento del relativo esame il conseguimento del patentino di saldatura. Tipo di contratto: CCNL METALMECCANICA INDUSTRIA Livello D2 RAL 25.732 + Integrativi aziendali - stabilizzazione da subito con contratto di 6 mesi o contratto di apprendistato (valutato sulla base dell'esperienza pregressa già maturata) Orario di lavoro: Dal lunedì al venerdì su giornata e 2 turni Sede di lavoro: Legnago e Villa Bartolomea (VR) Non perdere questa occasione: inviaci la tua candidatura e cogli l'opportunità di valorizzare le tue competenze in un ruolo chiave nel settore della metalmeccanica! title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: LOĢISTIKAS SPECIĀLISTS
description:
Tevi interesē transporta un loģistikas nozare un vēlies ar savu darbu veicināt videi drošu un efektīvi organizētu atkritumu apsaimniekošanas pakalpojumu nodrošināšanu? Aicinām pievienoties mūsu komandai LOĢISTIKAS SPECIĀLISTA amatā!

Darba pienākumi

  • Organizēt, plānot un koordinēt atkritumu apsaimniekošanas daļas transporta un loģistikas procesus.
  • Uzturēt un regulāri aktualizēt maršrutu datubāzi, veicot izmaiņas esošajos maršrutos atbilstoši pakalpojuma sniegšanas nosacījumiem.
  • Izstrādāt un plānot jaunus maršrutus, ņemot vērā pakalpojuma apjoma izmaiņas, jaunas pakalpojuma sniegšanas adreses un teritoriālo pārklājumu.
  • Nodrošināt atkritumu konteineru loģistikas plānošanu, uzstādīšanu un apstrādāt ar konteineru skaita, tilpuma vai izvietojuma izmaiņām saistīto informāciju datubāzē.
  • Veikt maršrutu un transporta darbības datu analīzi (nobraukums, laika patēriņš, degvielas patēriņš), sagatavojot priekšlikumus pakalpojuma efektivitātes uzlabošanai.
  • Sadarboties ar citām struktūrvienībām jautājumos, kas skar maršrutu un pakalpojuma sniegšanas plānošanu.
  • Veikt citus ar loģistikas procesu nodrošināšanu saistītus darba uzdevumus.

Piedāvājam

  • Iespēju pilnveidot savas zināšanas un iegūt praktisku pieredzi.
  • Nepilnu darba laiku – 20/h nedēļā.
  • Stabilu atalgojumu  1050,00 EUR (bruto) mēnesī un sociālās garantijas.
  • Stabilu darbu sociāli atbildīgā uzņēmumā, nozīmīgā un sabiedrībai svarīgā nozarē.
  • Veselības apdrošināšanu pēc pārbaudes laika.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Delivery Manager - Riga, Latvia
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Delivery Manager, you will ensure smooth execution of technical deliveries by maintaining structure across tasks, builds, and milestones, while acting as a key coordination point between engineering, QA, and stakeholders. This is a hands-on role combining delivery coordination, build and deployment execution, and technical troubleshooting. You will work closely with teams to ensure builds are consistently delivered, tested, and available for review, while keeping communication clear and expectations aligned across all parties.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Delivery & Coordination

    Maintain structure and visibility across ongoing deliverables, tasks, and milestones.
    Track ownership and deadlines, follow up on progress, and ensure timely execution.
    Participate in internal and external meetings to capture requirements, decisions, and action items.
    Document outcomes of discussions to ensure clarity and continuity for the team.
    Maintain clear visibility of delivery status, dependencies, and potential risks.
    Support prioritization and coordination across teams without direct managerial authority.

Technical Execution

Work with existing tools and pipelines to:

    Create and manage builds.
    Deploy builds to target environments or devices.
    Prepare builds for internal testing and stakeholder review.
    Perform sanity checks, smoke testing, and basic validation of builds.
    Distribute deliverables to stakeholders and collect feedback.
    Troubleshoot build, deployment, or environment-related issues where possible.
    Act as a practical technical support layer for delivery and release activities.

Communication & Stakeholder Support

    Serve as a point of contact for delivery updates and build availability.
    Translate technical progress into clear, structured, and actionable updates.
    Ensure alignment of expectations between technical teams and stakeholders.
    Support transparent and consistent communication across all involved parties.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

    Strong hands-on technical background (software, tools, or build systems relevant to the team).
    Experience with build systems, deployment workflows, or CI/CD pipelines.
    Ability to set up, run, and test builds independently.
    Comfortable working with existing tools and adapting to new ones quickly.
    Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
    Professional proficient in spoken and written English (knowledge of English is required, as the company is international and it is necessary to communicate in English with foreign colleagues daily).
    Excellent organization and task-tracking abilities.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Comfortable working across disciplines (engineering, QA, stakeholders).
    High attention to detail and follow-through.
    Proactive, self-driven, and reliable.

NICE TO HAVE

    Experience in game development, software delivery, or technical production roles.
    Familiarity with Agile or iterative development workflows.
    Previous experience acting as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
    Basic scripting or automation experience.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

    Monthly salary from 3700 EUR to 5500 EUR gross/per month.
    Health insurance from the first day of employment.
    Paid parking next to the office as required.
    On-site work model: 5 days from the office.
    Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development.
    Taking part in creating studios as part of an award-winning iGaming business.
    Truly international experience and collaboration possibilities with impactful results.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

priima iš asmenų prašymus dėl TPP skyrimo, padeda juos užpildyti, surenka visus reikalingus duomenis ir (ar) dokumentus arba jų kopijas, informuoja asmenis apie turimas TPP, nustato TPP poreikį ir priima sprendimus dėl TPP skyrimo, parenka ir individualiai pritaiko TPP, apmoko jomis naudotis.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

title: Analyst, Same Day Topology, LTP (m/f)
description:
Analyst, Same Day Topology, LTP
Job ID: 10486914 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Have you ever ordered a product on the Amazon website and wondered how it got delivered to you via Same Day, and what kinds of topology, demand and capacity processes are running behind the scenes to power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for steering our LTP topology to deliver end-to-end benefits across Customer Experience, Speed, and Cost. This is a role for an exceptionally talented person, with high energy and courage, passionate about ambiguity and delivering concrete improvements for our customers, and who wants to achieve that using data. The role is split 70% analytics and 30% project management.
The key job responsibilities can be split in two buckets:

(1) Data Analytics/Science

- Deep dive complex data to uncover actionable insights for known and unknown problems
- Good expertise with SQL techniques
- Build strong analytics tools to highlight defects and extract actionable insights from our end-to-end supply chain

(2) Project management:

- Lead regular business reviews with partner teams to monitor progress of projects in the roadmap, and help remove bottlenecks
- Use and share your insights with partner teams to influence and build a roadmap of projects that accelerate speed of deliveries in your country
- For the most complex and ambitious opportunities, quickly launch new pilots and build scale-up business cases with benefits, bottlenecks, risks, and resources required
- Consolidate progress into crisp, concise, data-driven status updates. You will own reporting to Amazon senior leadership.

A day in the life

You'll work across First Mile and Last Mile topology teams to shape the physical network that powers Same Day: classifying and sizing node types (Nexus, dedicated Same Day sites, standard fulfillment sites), evaluating RE candidates against coverage and capacity needs, and reconciling demand against what the network can realistically serve at a regional and site level. You'll turn that analysis into a prioritized roadmap and drive it through recurring workshops with Real Estate, Topology, Finance, and Science partners, tracking action items to closure and reporting progress up to senior leadership.

About the team

Long Term Planning Analytics Team

- Same Day Topology LTP is one of those analytical teams. We are obsessed by rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our products can be delivered the same-day.
- Long Term Planning analytical teams are transversal centers of expertise, composed of engineers, analysts, and scientists. We are focused on Amazon most complex problems, processes and decisions. We work with fulfillment centers, transportation, finance and retail teams across the world, to improve our logistic infrastructure.

- Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion. We improve customer experience through continuously optimizing the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Ability to lead and structure projects, in particular liaising and collaborating with internal partners to influence direction and roadmaps, despite competing priorities
Preferred Qualifications
- Ability to progress autonomously in ambiguous environment

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


CDD, full-time, ref: [HTIPC26]
Service: National Business Relationship Management
Hierarchical Superior: Director, Business Relationship Management



About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.

Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.


Job mission:


Department description:

The Business Relationship Management division builds and maintains strategic relationships with Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. Within this division, the HealthTech team supports the development and competitiveness of Luxembourg's health technologies sector — spanning medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation — by connecting companies to relevant programmes, research organisations and European initiatives.


Job description:

As a HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator, you will drive the operational management and strategic coordination of healthtech-related projects at national and European level. You will coordinate the activities of the HealthTech team members, ensuring that project milestones are delivered on time and within budget, while fostering collaboration between internal colleagues, consortium partners, research organisations and Luxembourg-based companies across the health technologies value chain.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.


Main tasks and responsibilities:

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:


Inspire:

Monitor technological, regulatory and market developments across the healthtech landscape (medtech, digital health, biotech, pharma) and translate insights into actionable opportunities for the ecosystem
Contribute to the design and implementation of Luxinnovation's HealthTech strategy and annual work programme, aligned with national health innovation priorities
Represent Luxinnovation in healthtech-related fora, conferences and working groups at national and European level
Promote Luxembourg's healthtech ecosystem and its competitive advantages to international partners and stakeholders


Assess & Accelerate:

Manage the operational delivery of healthtech innovation projects, ensuring alignment with consortium work plans, KPIs and budgets
Coordinate the contributions of the HealthTech team members across active projects, ensuring clarity of roles, coherent planning and timely delivery of individual and collective workstreams
Track project progress through regular reporting (CRM, European project management systems), flag risks and propose corrective actions
Identify companies' innovation needs within the healthtech sector and assess their potential to participate in collaborative R&D projects
Support companies in navigating regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (e.g., EU Medical Device Regulation, European Health Data Space)


Connect:

Serve as the central coordination point within the HealthTech team, facilitating information flow, aligning priorities and ensuring synergies between team members' respective activities and project portfolios
Coordinate with consortium partners, research organisations and institutional stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and knowledge exchange
Facilitate matchmaking between Luxembourg healthtech companies and international partners for collaborative innovation projects
Act as an internal interface, connecting healthtech project activities with other Luxinnovation services (funding, market intelligence, digitalisation)
Develop and maintain professional relationships across the national and European healthtech ecosystem


Fund:

Support Luxembourg companies in accessing European healthtech funding programmes (Horizon Europe Health Cluster, EIT Health, Innovative Health Initiative, Digital Europe Programme)
Ensure compliant budget tracking, timesheet management and financial reporting for all projects under your coordination
Identify synergies between national RDI funding instruments and European healthtech calls to maximise funding opportunities for ecosystem actors
Contribute to the preparation and submission of new collaborative project proposals in the healthtech domain


This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.


Required competencies:

Education level and professional experience required:

University degree at Master's level (Bac+4/5) in life sciences, biomedical engineering, health economics, public health, business management or equivalent
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in project coordination or management within the healthtech, life sciences or health innovation sector
Proven experience managing multi-partner collaborative projects (national or European)
Experience coordinating small cross-functional teams or workgroups
Knowledge of European R&D programme structures (Horizon Europe, EIT Health, IHI) is a strong asset
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) is desirable


Specific competencies:

Solid understanding of the health technologies landscape, including medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation
Proven ability to manage complex project portfolios with multiple workstreams, partners and deadlines
Strong team coordination skills, with the ability to align diverse contributors around shared objectives and delivery timelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical health innovation challenges into structured project plans
Excellent stakeholder engagement and diplomatic skills across institutional, academic and private-sector actors
Knowledge of Luxembourg's socio-economic environment and health innovation ecosystem is an asset
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (EU MDR, IVDR, European Health Data Space) is an advantage


Languages:

Fluent English and French are mandatory (oral and written, minimum C1 level)
German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset


IT Skills:

MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and MS Project or equivalent
CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
European project management platforms (e.g., EC Funding & Tenders Portal, JEMS)
Knowledge of collaboration and reporting tools (Teams, SharePoint)


Why choose this position?

This role places you at the intersection of health innovation, European R&D policy and team leadership. You will coordinate a dedicated team of healthtech specialists while managing high-impact projects that accelerate the adoption of health technologies in Luxembourg. Join a collaborative environment where your expertise in project coordination and your passion for healthtech will contribute directly to strengthening Luxembourg's position as a competitive player in the European health innovation landscape.


Application:

Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us! [...]

title: Alternative Investment Fund Depositary Bank Officer (m/f)
description:

ALTERNATIVE INVESTMENT FUND DEPOSITARY BANK OFFICER (M/F)

title: Banking Operations Officer - Cash Transfers (Fixed-Term Contract - 12 months) (m/f)
employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Transaction Officer - Cash to join our Banking Operations team. The primary responsibility of this role is to process IN/OUT payment transactions efficiently and accurately, ensuring seamless operations across various payment systems and customer categories.

Your role

• Process, invoice, and validate payment orders across systems such as TARGET, SEPA (SCT/SDD), and cash correspondent networks
• Handle transactions for all customer categories, including PWM, PAS FRONT, FPS, and PAM PAI, in all currencies and for all BPAG entities (7 Business Units)
• Manage incoming SWIFT MX and SEPA messages (Pacs.00x & Camt.0xx)
• Reconcile suspense items and monitor investigation files
• Ensure accurate accounting of incoming funds via SWIFT, SEPA, TARGET, and BACS for our customers
• Analyze and process reversals, cheque cashing, and issue requests
• Perform first-level processing of Fircosoft hits
• Manage standing orders, including creation, validation, and closure
• Process SWIFT FreeText eT Broadcast messages
• Enter, correct, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages in the AMH system
