title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). Expertise IA: Maîtrise des techniques de Machine Learning et d'Advanced Analytics (clustering, Random Forest, Boosting, réseaux de neurones, NLP, etc.); Expertise approfondie en Privacy Enhancing Technologies (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, agrégation, suppression, généralisation, etc.); Expérience dans l'évaluation de modèles, la conception de suites de tests et l'analyse des limites des algorithmes; Connaissance des modèles de langage et des outils d'IA générative appliqués à des cas d'usage privacy et confidentialité. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez...

title: Sr. Technical Vehicle Program Manager, Vehicle Performance, Launch and Evaluation (m/f)
description:
Sr. Technical Vehicle Program Manager, Vehicle Performance, Launch and Evaluation team
Job ID: 10496669 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

The Senior Technical Program Manager will be responsible for optimizing the technical attributes of our last-mile vehicle fleet. You will own critical work-streams that focus on keeping our EU fleet at the highest possible standard. You will strive to always be data driven while making judgements from the field to ensure the corrects actions are made to protect the customer, the fleet and operations. The strive to be data driven means that x-functional relationships are key for success. To be successful in this role, you possess strong technical capabilities with an equally strong ability to analyze, solve and communicate complex problems. A successful candidate will be analytical, resourceful, customer-focused and team oriented. The candidate will have a proven track record in navigating complex technical problem settings, being hands on in finding fact-based solutions, in a technical capacity in the automotive industry – preferably with commercial vehicles, and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment.

The Last Mile team within Amazon Logistics is looking for Senior Technical Program Manager to drive Amazon Logistics technical fleet capabilities. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One experience that we are constantly improving is how we fulfill and deliver orders right to the customer's doorstep. Our goal is to exceed the expectations of all our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small are delivered where and when they need them, as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class delivery experiences through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the Last Mile Delivery space. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the rapidly growing Amazon Logistics organization. The Last Mile initiative is a highly visible program (internally and with our customers). Come join our team and help us make history!

Key job responsibilities

- Owns the optimization of technical attributes of our expanding vehicle fleet and innovates on behalf our customers
- Is capable of taking accountability and driving planning, resolution and execution in complex technical projects.
- Works independently, has a strong drive to identify improvement potential and manages projects from idea to implementation.
- Is comfortable challenging internal stakeholders on existing practices and external partners in their limitations and capabilities.
- Strong ownership and bias for action; ability to internalize goals and work independently to create appropriate action plans for those goals.
- Strong analytical orientation; comfort using databases and analytical tools and making data-based decisions.
- Strong Project management capabilities; An ability to assess risks, make decisions, manage execution and report accordingly.

A day in the life

A day in the life of a VPLE team member is never the same. title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

title: Cyber Security Analyst – Audit (m/f)
description:
Cyber Security Analyst – Audit

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.
• Experience in global and multi-regulatory environments.
• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

title: Network Relationship Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Network Relationship Manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

Within Clearstream, Global Markets – Network Management is responsible for managing Clearstream's worldwide network of financial market infrastructures and service providers, including central securities depositories, custodian banks, cash correspondent banks, and trading venues.
The main responsibilities of Network Management are to select, develop and monitor the global network of third-party service providers for settlement, custody and cash correspondent banking services. The work includes notably the continuous assessment of the levels of service, competitiveness and the associated risks of those markets where Clearstream operates a link. Network Management also ensures at all times compliance with Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's policies and procedures and their regulatory requirements applicable to the management of its market links and agent bank network.

The Network Management Office (NMO) is a transversal control, coordination and governance function that supports and oversees the Network Management teams globally. Its mandate is not market ownership, but process integrity, consistency, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across the entire Network Management function. This is a cross functional role combining governance, process management, regulatory awareness, audit coordination, and stakeholder interaction.

Your responsibilities:

• Establishing and monitoring the contractual relationships with Clearstream's third party providers, from leading the RFIs/RFPs to concluding contracts
• Reviewing and negotiating fee schedules, taking into account the market specifics and competition
• Monitoring compliance with all applicable market and regulatory requirements
• Monitoring adherence to operational service levels, from a contractual and competitive standpoint
• Sourcing and communicating all information about allocated markets in a timely and relevant fashion, for all stakeholders
• Performing on-site due diligence visits (a few business trips per year may be necessary)
• Maintaining the evaluation of the market requirements and their risk assessments
• Representing and advocating for Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse in forums and in the interactions with all layers of the markets: participants, regulators, infrastructures, etc.
• Business analysis of Settlement and Custody related products
• Cross-departmental coordination of market developments/projects
• Governance & Oversight: providing a centralised governance and control over the above-mentioned Network Management activities to ensure execution of the Network Management Procedure, acting as a control and coordination layer between regional Network Management teams and other internal stakeholders (audit, compliance, etc)
• Procedures & Regulatory Alignment: responsible for the administration, maintenance and consistency of Network Management procedures that are filed with Clearstream's regulators, coordinating annual and adhoc updates and ensuring the audit and regulatory requirements are correctly documented.
• Audit & Assurance Support: act as the central audit interface for Network Management, coordinating external and internal audit requests and ensuring evidence, documentation and controls are consistently available.
• Process Coordinationg & Steering: organise and coordinate Network Management Steering Committees in order to facilitate internal alignment on processes, controls and priorities, supporting the escalation and alignment of transversal issues affecting the Network Management team as a whole
• Systems & Data Governance: supporting the consistent usage of the Network Management system (DigiNet) plus other systems and tools available to the team, to ensure quality data standards and disciplined documentation storage practices.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree, post-graduate degree or MBA, in economics / finance or equivalent
• 3-5 years of securities services experience or any equivalent financial enviornment
• Background in governance, operational risk, compliance, audit coordination, or process management
• Experience working with cross border or distributed teams is an advantage
• Strong organisational and coordination skills
• High attention to detail and structured working style
• Ability to understand complex processes and translate them into clear frameworks
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and control functions
• Strong negotiation, presentation and analytical skills, enabling the interactions with all levels of management, internally and with clients and service providers.
• Ability to represent Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's agenda and interests with industry participants and bodies, including the relevant regulators.
• Ability to set and prioritize objectives, to contribute to the wider departmental and organisational objectives, to proactively source, interact or develop talent, collaborate with the team and across the company. Able to work independently, be a team player, and offer up effective recommendations to management or counterparts.
• Understanding of compliance with regulations applicable to securities and cash services, remaining current as regulatory agendas evolve.
• Very comfortable and effective at running meetings, interfacing in culturally diverse environments, with teams and colleagues working across multiple time zones, and with global partners and clients.
• Spoken and written fluency in business English is a mandatory requirement. Proficiency in additional languages, are advantageous.
• Effective knowledge of MS office products (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word), SAP and SWIFT very beneficial.

Job Description:

Reporting to the Supplier Quality Manager, the Supplier Quality Analyst (SQA) in collaboration with the Quality at the Source (QATS) Engineer for their supply lane to execute activities aiming to ensure that all supplied components within their portfolio of regional suppliers are ready to use when reaching internal or external customers.

The Supplier Quality Analyst is the primary point of contact both internally and externally for all activities related to Quality at their suppliers.  They will answer all quality related inquiries and will enhance the compliance to Husky's qualification standards (i.e., re-qualify existing suppliers).

The Supplier Quality Analyst will monitor suppliers' performance, organize, and execute Supplier Audits, follow-up on Supplier Improvement Plans and execute Part Qualifications.

In collaboration with the Clinic team, the Supplier Quality Analyst will support root cause analysis & permanent corrective actions.


Responsibilities:

Define & execute supplier surveillance audit plans to maintain or re-qualify existing suppliers according to latest Husky standards.
Define supplier improvement plans, follow-up on action implementation and effectiveness at suppliers.
Monitor supplier performance & proactively act or react accordingly.
Manage Part Qualifications for their suppliers.
Participate in Andon & Clinic activities related to their suppliers.
Support and verify execution of containment actions at suppliers.
Support execution of containment actions at Supplier
Contribute to Root Cause Analysis and Permanent Corrective Action determination and follow-up on implementation at supplier.
Partner with stakeholders for execution of Andon/Clinic tasks outside of direct area of responsibilities
Support new supplier qualification.
Participate in the continuous improvement of methods & standard of Supply Chain Quality Management System


Qualifications and Skills:

Engineering, Supplier Audit Certification is preferred.
5 years' Quality/Project Management/Supply Chain experience: technical, supply chain or operations role with process development
Strong Quality background required. Good understanding of Quality needs (e.g., what internal/external suppliers provide, what customers expect, and what performance measurement metrics are)
Understanding of tools and processes related to Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP); ability to facilitate sessions with partners.
Good technical understanding of Supplier's manufacturing, assembly, logistic processes - be able to evaluate sound of a process even without having a deep technical knowledge. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and define corrective action.
Ability to apply an analytical, process-oriented approach to solving problems across a variety of situations and activities.
Ownership, accountability, and confidence to take decisions. Be able to ability to work in ambiguity.
Strong project and change management skills.
Hands-on data collection and analysis skills, with a high attention to detail
Ability to work in a fast-changing environment with a willingness to change, flexibility and learning agility.
Excellent problem-solving skills and tenacity to drive the resolution to conclusion.
Understanding of lean principles to enhance quality process design and operations.
Understands the need and benefit of Quality Assurance
Understanding of ISO Quality Management System requirements & business/industry standards
Excellent written and spoken command of English and German, additional languages are a plus.
Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills
Good understanding of Husky's product design, standards, and manufacturing technologies for a wide range of product types; process engineering can be generic/agnostic of product.
Travel required at Supplier (25%)


Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Job Description

You will provide temporary assistance to our Global Trade Compliance Team i.e. you will complete the actual screening and assessment of dual use items. This is a temporary assigneent for 6 months with a starting date as of October 1st, 2026.

• Develop and apply best practices to operating models across Securities Services.
• Act as an escalation point for internal support functions and clients, resolving issues as needed.

• Strong interpersonal, communication and influencing skills.

description:

Since 1922, Rotarex has been the world leader in cylinder valves, pressure regulators and equipment for all gas applications. With nearly 2,000 employees worldwide, we support a wide range of industries including semiconductor, medical, automotive, food & beverage, energy, research and many others.

Innovation, quality and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do, making Rotarex a trusted partner for customers around the globe.

Manage the Firetec products and systems throughout the entire Product Lifecycle: ideation, development, introduction, growth, maturity, and end-of-life.
Gather and prioritize product and customer requirements, defining development scope and creating project initiation documentation.
Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, production, marketing, purchasing, and sales for successful product development. Manage small scale projects.
Drive cross-functional product launches and business planning processes.
Develop, implement, and maintain production timelines across multiple departments.


Training & Communication:

Provide technical and commercial training for internal and external customers. Collaborate on training materials creation and updates.


Product Positioning & Strategy:

Develop positioning and messaging for Rotarex Firetec products.
Maintain and enhance costing and pricing tools. Identify and define cost reduction strategies.
Assess competitor offerings and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Analyze consumer needs, market trends, and potential partnerships for strategic decision-making.



Your profile:

Qualifications:

Leadership and teamwork: Assign tasks, negotiate, and engage in cross-functional teams.
Adaptability: Quickly shift focus to changing priorities with minimal stress.
Communication: Effectively transmit information, adapt to different audiences, and comfortable speaking in public.
Problem Solving: Identify problems promptly and actively seek solutions.
Commercial awareness and customer focus: Understand business success factors and prioritize customer needs.

Bachelor's degree in product design, engineering, or business administration.
5-year experience in fire suppression or correlated industry.
Involved in dynamic product management, in manufacturing industry.
Experience overseeing multiple elements of the product development lifecycle.
Exceptional writing, editing, presentation, and public speaking skills.
Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or German.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and 365 packages.


What makes this role unique:

Responsibility for the full Product Lifecycle of Rotarex Firetec products and systems
Cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Production, Marketing, Purchasing and Sales
Involvement in product development, product launches and business planning
A role combining product management, technical and commercial activities
Opportunities to contribute to product positioning, differentiation, costing, pricing and cost reduction strategies
Direct involvement in understanding customer needs, market trends and competitor offerings



What you will find at Rotarex:

The strength of a global industrial group combined with a family-oriented culture
Real opportunities for training, development and career growth
Flexible working hours (depending on the position) promoting a healthy work-life balance
An attractive benefits package including additional holidays, bonuses and social benefits
Soon, a new Industry 4.0 manufacturing site in Bissen, offering an ultra-modern working environment (canteens, fitness center, free parking, electric vehicle charging stations, air-conditioned facilities...)
Easy access to the site
Additional benefits including Sympass, preferential partnerships (banking, health insurance, mobile plans...)
Company events that foster team spirit and collaboration


Recruitment process:

1st interview: Teams interview with HR and the Hiring Manager
2nd interview: On-site interview


Only applications submitted through our official application process will be considered.
All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality.


A small tip: AI-generated applications often sound alike… let your personality and experience make the difference

Ready to take the next step in your product management career with Rotarex? Join us and contribute to the development of innovative Firetec products and systems.

title: Junior Derivative Valuation Specialist (m/f) - Job based in Luxembourg
description:
Junior Derivative Valuation Specialist (m/f) - Job based in Luxembourg
Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg
Job Function:  Audit & Assurance
Seniority:  Junior
Contract Type:  Open-term

Your future team

Our team of valuation experts are specialized in quantitative analysis and the valuation of financial derivatives instruments along with other complex products and structures for banks and investment funds. The team works closely with our Audit & Assurance department. It provides, in the context of the audit of investments funds and credit institutions, derivatives valuations in respect of client's portfolios.
Our team also provides quantitative expertise to the finance, banking and insurance industry sectors. This includes the review of valuation frameworks, policies and processes as well as gap analysis versus regulatory requirements, market practices and regulatory expectations.
Your advantages of joining us

1. Career Growth, Your Way
Access top-notch training and career development, with a clear progression path to help you level up at your own pace.
2. Global Impact, Local Connections
Work on international projects and collaborate with diverse teams, all while making an impact locally.
3. Innovative Work That Matters
Tackle cutting-edge projects and utilize the latest tech, with all the tools you need to stay ahead.
4. Inclusive, Flexible Culture
Embrace a culture where your voice matters, with flexible hours to balance work and life seamlessly.
5. Purpose-Driven Work
Get involved in sustainability initiatives and community service, making a real difference while growing your career.

How you'll contribute to our success

• Calculate and report fair value of derivatives, reconciling with accounting records
• Work with a broad range of OTC derivatives (rates, FX, credit, equity, structured products, illiquid instruments, etc)
• Develop and apply quantitative models and IT solutions for derivative valuation and process improvement
• Design, implement, test, document and maintain valuation models, systems, policies and frameworks
• Conduct reviews, gap analyses and provide support on valuation topics, including regulatory requirements and internal reviews

Your skills

Must have

• Master's degree in Finance, Engineering or Applied Mathematics with a strong willingness to develop expertise in the financial sector
• Experience in the financial sector and knowledge of related regulations, plus knowledge of financial instruments (bonds, shares, derivatives, funds, …)
• Strong basics in derivatives pricing or mathematics and solid programming skills in Matlab, Python, R or another language
• Good team player able to work autonomously, agile, enthusiastic, results oriented, able to work within deadlines, and fluent in English

Nice to have

• Passion for problem solving with excellent analytical skills
• French or German language skills
• Knowledge of the main Financial Information Providers (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, …)

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

title: Senior Affiliate Manager - Malta

If you’re passionate about affiliation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Affiliate Manager. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Affiliate Manager to lead and grow our affiliate partnerships across Sportsbook and Casino verticals.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key affiliates, driving new business opportunities, optimizing partner performance, and delivering sustainable revenue growth.

This role requires a strong understanding of the sportsbook affiliate landscape, player acquisition strategies, sports betting products, and performance marketing.

The ideal candidate combines relationship management expertise with analytical skills and a proven ability to negotiate, execute, and scale affiliate partnerships in highly competitive markets.

Accountabilities:

· Act as the primary point of contact for affiliate accounts, ensuring exceptional service and support.

· Conduct regular performance reviews and business discussions with partners.

· Identify growth opportunities and implement strategies to maximize affiliate revenue and player acquisition.

Sportsbook Focus

· Develop affiliate campaigns specifically focused on Sportsbook acquisition and retention.

· Work closely with the Trading, CRM, and Marketing teams to leverage major sporting events and seasonal opportunities.

· Ensure affiliates are effectively promoting sportsbook products, offers, and content.

· Monitor sportsbook performance trends, betting markets, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities.

· Collaborate on pre-event and event-driven acquisition strategies around major sporting events.

Performance & Analysis

· Deliver regular performance reports, forecasts, and actionable insights.

· Track affiliate profitability and ensure commercial objectives are achieved.

Essential

· Proven track record of managing and growing high-value affiliate partnerships.

· Experience negotiating CPA, Revenue Share, Hybrid, and tenancy agreements.

· Excellent commercial awareness and negotiation abilities.

· Strong organizational and project management skills.

title: Failure Test Engineer
description:
Failure Analysis Engineer (Test) Wij zijn op zoek naar een Failure Analysis Engineer die enthousiast is over het achterhalen van de kernoorzaak van technische problemen en het continu verbeteren van processen in een dynamische, internationale werkomgeving. Heb jij een technische achtergrond, maar steek je ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen aan machines? Dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou! Werkzaamheden Uitvoeren van Root Cause Analyses (RCA) op complexe elektronische en mechatronische systemen die retour komen van klanten of vanuit onze interne productie. Jouw bevindingen zijn essentieel voor het kwaliteitsteam bij het definiëren van verbeteringen en het oplossen van faalmodi. Samenwerken met kwaliteits-, ontwikkelings- en productieafdelingen om problemen op te lossen en de betrouwbaarheid van producten te verbeteren. Verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en implementeren van containmentmaatregelen om non-conforme producten te beheren en een soepele productieflow te ondersteunen. Vertalen van jouw analyses naar concrete verbeteracties voor toekomstige productontwikkeling en procesoptimalisatie. Arbeidsvoorwaarden 25 betaalde vakantiedagen (exclusief nationale feestdagen) Flexibele werktijden Gratis toegang tot de bedrijfsfitness Dagelijks gratis lunch, diner en gezonde snacks op locatie beschikbaar Wat levert deze baan jou op? Veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling met een individueel leer- en groeiplan Uitgebreide doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen diverse functies en projecten Wat breng jij mee? Een bachelor (BSc of BEng) in Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Een sterk analytisch vermogen en een oplossingsgerichte mentaliteit. Een scherpe blik voor detail en een praktische instelling. Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en het nemen van eigenaarschap over jouw werk. Een echte teamspeler met focus op gezamenlijke doelen. Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Oprechte interesse in

elektronica en productkwaliteit. Hier kom je te werken Bij onze klant ontwerpen en produceren we geavanceerde technologie die industrieën aandrijft en de wereld met elkaar verbindt. Met meer dan 500 unieke producten in uiteenlopende domeinen streven zij ernaar om de wereld slimmer en duurzamer te laten functioneren.

title: Begeleider Specialistische zorg (16u-36u)
description:
Als begeleider Specialistische zorg ben jij degene die écht ziet wat een cliënt nodig heeft. Je voelt aan hoe iemand zich voelt en past jouw begeleiding hierop aan. Of dat nu begint met een warme glimlach bij het ontbijt of een rustige wandeling in de avond. Samen met je collega's zorg je voor een veilige, vertrouwde en gezellige sfeer waarin cliënten zich gezien en gehoord voelen.

Functie:

Als begeleider specialistische zorg ben je er vooral voor de cliënten. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de doelen van het zorgplan en zorg je ervoor dat de cliënten een goede dag hebben. Daarnaast draag je ook bij aan de algemene teamtaken, zoals bijvoorbeeld het netjes houden van de woning.
Je komt te werken op een woning waar cliënten specialistische zorg nodig hebben. Deze cliënten hebben vaak een ernstige-, en of meervoudige beperking, die specifiek aandacht vragen voor gedragsmatige en/of intensieve (lichamelijke) zorg.

Intensieve zorg:
Je begeleidt de cliënt in zijn of haar ritme van de dag. Op sommige woningen ondersteun je en stimuleer je de cliënt zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en op andere woningen neem je de zorg over.

Gedragsmatige zorg:
Bij gedragsmatige zorg begeleid je cliënten die gedrag vertonen die moeilijk te begrijpen is, zoals agressie. Door zorgvuldig te observeren en klein te kunnen kijken, bied je hen de structuur en veiligheid die ze nodig hebben. Met een rustige houding en veel geduld weet jij passende ondersteuning te bieden, afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van de cliënt.

Daarnaast:

  • Ondersteun je bewoners bij hun dagelijkse ritme: van opstaan tot naar bed gaan. Bij de ene cliënt is dit meer gericht op ondersteuning, bij de ander meer op Algemene Dagelijkse Levensverrichtingen (ADL);

  • Zorg je voor een echt thuis voor de cliënten waar ze zich veilig voelen.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je een goed beeld krijgt en nemen je graag mee in de mogelijkheden bij Lunet. Tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met een van onze recruiters gaan we dan ook samen bekijken welke woning het beste aansluit bij jouw wensen en jouw talenten.

Wij vragen:

Relevante opleiding Zorg en Welzijn, niveau 3. We gaan graag met je in gesprek om te ontdekken welke vaardigheden en eigenschappen jij kunt inzetten in deze functie.

Wij vragen al onze nieuwe medewerkers om een “Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag” (VOG) te overhandigen voor hun functie binnen Lunet.

Je begeleidt de cliënt in zijn of haar ritme van de dag. Op sommige woningen ondersteun je en stimuleer je de cliënt zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en op andere woningen neem je de zorg over.

Bij gedragsmatige zorg begeleid je cliënten die gedrag vertonen die moeilijk te begrijpen is, zoals agressie. title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

Kuhlmann Europe ontwikkelt chemische oplossingen voor waterbehandeling. title: Service Technician
description:
Do you enjoy working with your hands, like variety in your job, and want to see the results of your work every day? At Amtra Mobiele Ruimte, you'll work on a wide range of projects across the Benelux. One day you'll be assembling modular units on-site, the next you'll be carrying out maintenance or coordinating a team of technicians. No two days are the same. Earn between €2,700 and €3,700 gross per month while building your future with a growing family-owned company. What’s your job about? As a Service Technician / Site Supervisor, you will be responsible for assembling, dismantling, maintaining and delivering modular units at customer locations. You will work independently or together with colleagues on a variety of projects, ensuring everything is completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. Your responsibilities include: Assembling, dismantling and maintaining modular units; Installing walls, doors, locks and fittings; Performing carpentry, sawing, painting and finishing work; Installing electrical wiring and lighting; Making units windproof and watertight; Coordinating technicians and maintenance activities on-site; Reading CAD drawings and translating them into practical execution; Managing construction and installation materials. What skills do you have? You are a practical and motivated professional who enjoys taking responsibility. You like working at different locations and get energy from hands-on technical work. In addition, you have: MBO-level education or equivalent, preferably in a technical field; Experience in assembly, construction, installation or technical maintenance; A valid category B driving licence; A VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one; The ability to read technical drawings, or the motivation to learn; A good command of the English language (Dutch is considered an advantage); A customer-focused, accurate and solution-oriented mindset. What do you get in return? A gross monthly salary between €2,700 and €3,700, depending

on your experience and skills; A full-time position within a stable and growing family-owned company; A varied job with projects across the Netherlands and Belgium; Opportunities to follow technical training courses and obtain certifications; Excellent career development opportunities; Competitive primary and secondary employment conditions; A friendly and informal working environment where colleagues support each other. Amtra B.V. specialises in the rental and installation of modular units for both temporary and long-term accommodation solutions. From its Dutch branch, the company delivers projects throughout the Benelux. Amtra is part of a German family-owned business with more than 25 years of experience. Quality, teamwork and short communication lines are at the heart of the organisation. You'll join an informal team where people work hard, help each other and enjoy building impressive projects together.

title: Divisjonsdirektør spesialisthelsetjenester og internasjonalt samarbeid
description:
Vil du være med å forme fremtidens helsetjeneste? Vi søker divisjonsdirektør for divisjon spesialisthelsetjenester i Helsedirektoratet
Helsedirektoratet er en statlig fag- og myndighetsetat underlagt Helse- og omsorgs-departementet. Direktoratet er en sentral faglig rådgiver innen helse, har en rekke myndighets- og forvaltningsoppgaver, og har en pådriverrolle for utviklingen av helse- og omsorgssektoren med et spesielt ansvar knyttet til helsefremmende arbeid, kvalitetsforbedring, samordning og digitalisering. Videre skal direktoratet iverksette nasjonal helsepolitikk, levere analyser og kunnskap som støtte for helsetjenesten og sørge for en god helseberedskap. Direktoratet har som mål å bidra til god folkehelse, reduserte helseforskjeller, samordnede og kunnskapsbaserte helsetjenester, trygge og likeverdige helsetjenester, samt styrket samfunnssikkerhet og beredskap i helsesektoren.

Det er avgjørende å legge til rette for en bærekraftig utvikling av den offentlige helsetjenesten sett i lys av den demografiske og medisinsk-teknologiske utviklingen, i tillegg til økende mangel på helsepersonell. Dette tilsier behov for prioritering, omstilling, innovasjon, tjenesteutvikling og bedre samhandling mellom primær- og spesialisthelsetjenesten.  


Rolle og ansvar

Som divisjonsdirektør får du ansvar for Helsedirektoratets arbeid med å understøtte en bærekraftig utvikling med spesielt ansvar for spesialisthelsetjenesten, og for å bidra til bedre samhandling med kommunale helse- og omsorgtjenester og andre sektorer. I denne rollen må du ha god dialog med og innsikt i spesialisthelsetjenesten, og med andre sentrale aktører innen helsesektoren inkludert Helse- og omsorgsdepartementet. Viktige ansvarsområder vil blant annet være samhandling, tjenesteutvikling, faglige retningslinjer og veiledere for spesialisthelsetjenesten (somatikk, psykisk helsevern og rusbehandling), screening, kvalitetsforbedring og pasientsikkerhet, bioteknologi, legemiddelområdet inkludert legemiddelberedskap, genteknologi og persontilpasset medisin, samt internasjonalt arbeid.

Divisjonsdirektør sitter i direktoratets toppledergruppe, inngår i direktoratets kriseledelse og rapporterer til helsedirektør.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du må kunne lede divisjonen strategisk, operativt og faglig, og vil samtidig ha personalansvar for andre ledere. Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Sikre at divisjonens arbeid, prioriteringer og beslutninger er forankret i direktoratets strategi og verdier
  • Legge realistiske planer for gjennomføring av arbeidsoppgaver, oppnå fastsatte resultater, levere på tid og holde budsjett
  • Bidra til det helhetlige arbeidet i direktoratet og til at direktoratet innfrir samfunnsoppdraget
  • Bidra til videreutvikling av og en bærekraftig spesialisthelsetjeneste
  • Representere direktoratet utad

Videre er det som en del av arbeidet viktig å informere og aktivt involvere, samt gi konstruktive tilbakemeldinger til lederkolleger og medarbeidere.
Andre og endrede arbeidsoppgaver kan bli tillagt stillingen. 

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker en god og trygg leder som har faglig autoritet og personlig integritet. Vi er ute etter deg med et bredt samfunnsengasjement og med god rolleforståelse. For å lykkes som vår nye divisjonsdirektør må du ha:

  • Medisinskfaglig utdanning, eller høyere helsefaglig utdanning på minst mastergradsnivå
  • Ledererfaring fra større offentlig eller privat virksomhet med personal-, resultat- og budsjettansvar
  • Relevant erfaring fra spesialisthelsetjenesten og fra beredskapsarbeid
  • God innsikt i helseforvaltningen
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er ønskelig med forskningskompetanse, erfaring med endrings- og utviklingsprosesser, erfaring med digital transformasjon og kunnskap om internasjonalt helsesamarbeid. Videre er det ønskelig med erfaring med mediehåndtering.

Det er et krav at du kan sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres for «HEMMELIG» og «NATO SECRET».

Personlige egenskaperSom divisjonsdirektør får du ansvar for å lede og utvikle divisjonen. Oppgaven som divisjonsdirektør er utfordrende og kompleks, og innebærer mulighet til å være med og utvikle fremtidens helsetjeneste. For å lykkes i stillingen, er det avgjørende at du har evne til å samarbeide og bygge gode relasjoner på tvers av ulike fagmiljøer – spesielt med sentrale miljø i spesialisthelsetjenesten. Du tenker strategisk og er analytisk, er innovativ og løsningsorientert, har god gjennomføringsevne og er resultatorientert. Det blir lagt særlig vekt på god rolleforståelse og personlig egnethet. Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende jobb med muligheter til å videreutvikle et viktig ansvarsområde i organisasjonen
  • Lønn som direktør (stillingskode 1062) i lønnsspennet 1 450 000 til 1 650 000. For særskilt kvalifiserte kandidater kan det vurderes noe høyere lønn.
  • Gode ordninger for pensjon, lån og forsikringer gjennom Statens pensjonskasse
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Moderne lokaler beliggende på Storo i Oslo
  • Stillingen som divisjonsdirektør er definert som en "ledende stilling" etter arbeidsmiljøloven §10-12 som gir unntak fra arbeidsmiljølovens bestemmelser om arbeidstid. 

I Helsedirektoratet får du kolleger som er stolte av jobben sin og utfører den med stort engasjement. Vi ønsker deg velkommen inn i et arbeidsfellesskap der tverrfaglig samarbeid er helt avgjørende. Vi tilbyr deg et faglig sterkt, dynamisk og raust miljø med høye ambisjoner og dyktige medarbeidere.

Mangfold i Helsedirektoratet 
Helsedirektoratet mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, livserfaring og perspektiv for å kunne bidra til en enda bedre oppgaveløsning.  

Offentliggjøring av søkerliste 
Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysningen om at du er søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten, jf. offentleglova § 25. 

Bakgrunnssjekk
Helsedirektoratet gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk i utvalgte rekrutteringer. Bakgrunnssjekken blir utført etter samtykke fra deg som søker, og innebærer blant annet at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. 

Søk elektronisk
Registrer søknaden din elektronisk innen søknadsfristen. Du må legge ved alle relevante attester og dokumentere din utdanning via Vitnemålsportalen, eller ved bekreftelse fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helsedirektoratet skal styrke hele befolkningens helse gjennom helhetlig og målrettet arbeid på tvers av tjenester, sektorer og forvaltningsnivå. Vår visjon er God helse – gode liv. Vi skal jobbe for å fremme helse og mestring og være pådrivere for sammenhengende og likeverdige helse- og omsorgstjenester. Vi skal også samordne Helse-Norge om en felles retning for digitalisering. Dette skal vi gjøre med utgangspunkt i rollen som fag- og myndighetsorgan. I tillegg har Helsedirektoratet et helhetlig ansvar for den nasjonale helseberedskapen. Vi er underlagt Helse- og omsorgsdepartementet og har kontorer i Oslo, Trondheim og Ålesund.

title: Studentmedarbeidere SoMe
description:
Om stillingen

Det matematisk-naturvitenskapelige fakultet søker to studentmedarbeidere til vårt sosiale medier-team. Hver av stillingene har en arbeidstid på ca. 10 timer per uke. 

Vi ser etter deg som bruker sosiale medier aktivt, liker å være der ting skjer, og som har lyst til å fortelle gode historier gjennom video, bilder og tekst. 

Hos oss får du være med på å utvikle og produsere innhold til sosiale medier på MN og UiO, hovedsakelig Instagram og TikTok. 
Du blir en del av fakultetets sosiale medier-team i kommunikasjonsseksjonen og samarbeider med andre studentmedarbeidere, kommunikasjonsrådgivere, forskere, undervisere og studenter. 

Vi håper å finne studenter som har minst ett til to år igjen av studiene, og som ønsker å være med og utvikle kanalene våre over tid.

Kontrakten varer i utgangspunktet til august 2027, men med mulighet for forlengelse.

Arbeidsted vil være på Blindern, Oslo.


Hva skal du gjøre?
  • Lage innhold til fakultetets sosiale medier, hovedsakelig Instagram (www.instagram.com/unioslo_mn) og TikTok (www.tiktok.com/@unioslo)
  • Produsere reels, videoer, stories, intervjuer og bilder
  • Finne gode historier og spennende personer å løfte frem
  • Intervjue studenter, forskere og ansatte
  • Delta i idéutvikling og redaksjonsmøter
  • Planlegge og koordinere produksjon av andres og egenprodusert innhold
  • Dekke arrangementer og aktiviteter på campus
  • Publisere og følge opp/monitorere innhold i kanalene våre

 Kvalifikasjonskrav
  • Er student ved MN eller er en realfagsinteressert UiO- student
  • Har minst ett til to år igjen av studiene
  • Bruker sosiale medier aktivt og har erfaring med å poste/ lage video og foto
  • Kommuniserer godt skriftlig og muntlig på norsk og engelsk

Vi ser etter deg som 
  • Er komfortabel med å intervjue folk, og være foran kamera
  • Har et godt øye for innhold
  • Liker å møte og snakke med mennesker
  • Har laget innhold til egne eller andres kanaler
  • Har erfaring med video, foto eller videoredigering
  • Har brukt vektøy som CapCut, Adobe Express, Canva eller lignende
  • Følger med på nye trender og formater i sosiale medier

Hva vi ser etter hos deg?

Personlige egenskaper

Du trenger ikke å være ekspert på alt. Det viktigste er at du er nysgjerring, kreativ og har lyst til å lære. Vi ser etter deg som tør å ta initiativ, er selvgående, liker å samarbeide med andre og har et godt øye for innhold. Til sammen skal dere lage innhold som viser frem både studentlivet, menneskene og forskningen ved MN-fakultetet.


Vi kan tilby deg
  • En spennende deltidsjobb midt på campus
  • Relevant erfaring innen kommunikasjon, sosiale medier og innholdsproduksjon
  • Muligheter til å utvikle feridhget innen video, foto og historiefortelling
  • Opplæring i videoredigering i Premiere Pro og Adobe Express
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid tilpasset studiene

Arbeidstid og lønn

Stillingene er studentstillinger med timelønn og en ramme på inntil 10 timer per uke og du blir ansatt i stillingskode som konsulent, 1065. Vi ser for oss at du jobber mellom 7 og 10 timer i gjennomsnitt, men mengden varierer gjennom året.

Jobben er fleksibel og lar seg godt kombinere med studier. Du kan ofte styre arbeidshverdagen selv, samtidig som vi forventer at du stiller opp på avtalte møter, arrangementer, intervjuer og andre oppdrag som må gjennomføres på dagtid. 

Lønnen er kr 227,69 per time. 


Vi trenger ulike perspektiver i vårt arbeid

UiO er et åpent og internasjonalt breddeuniversitet, og vil være en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass og studiested. Les mer om UiOs arbeid for likestilling, inkludering og mangfold på uio.no.

Vi løser vårt samfunnsoppdrag best når vi tar i bruk våre ulike erfaringer, bakgrunner og perspektiver. Vi vil gjerne ha flere gode kolleger - kanskje den neste er deg?

Vi vil tilrettelegge dersom du har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være endring av arbeidstid, tilpasning av arbeidsoppgaver, digital, teknisk, eller fysisk tilrettelegging eller andre praktiske tilpasninger.

Har du innvandrerbakgrunn, funksjonsnedsettelse eller hull i CV-en, oppfordrer vi deg til å krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert søker fra hver gruppe til intervju. Med funksjonsnedsettelse menes her en søker som oppgir å ha en funksjonsnedsettelse som vil medføre tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen eller i arbeidsforholdet. Les mer om kravene på Arbeidsgiverportalen.

Avkrysningene i jobbsøkerportalen blir brukt til anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter. Mer informasjon om likestillingstiltak ved UiO finner du her.

Vi håper at du søker på stillingen hos oss.


Hvordan søke på stillingen?

Søknaden må innholde:

Fortell oss litt om hvem du er og hvorfor du har lyst på stillingen, eller send en kort videosnutt hvor du presenterer deg selv. Legg ved CV. 
Har du laget annet innhold tidligere? Legg gjerne ved lenke til plattformer eller kontoer du har bidratt til. Det trenger ikke være profesjonelt arbeid. Egne prosjekter, studentforeninger, frivillig arbeid eller egne kontoer er minst like interessant for oss. 

Merk at hvis du vil søke med en video hvor du presenterer deg selv, må du legge egen lenke til denne i søknadsbrevet, da det ikke er mulig å laste opp video i søknadsportalen.

Søknad med vedlegg må sendes inn via vårt rekrutteringssystem Jobbnorge, klikk “Søk stillingen”.

Når du søker på stillingen, ber vi deg hente utdanningsresultatene dine fra Vitnemålsportalen.no. Om utdanningsresultatene dine ikke er tilgjengelige via Vitnemålsportalen, ber vi deg laste opp kopier av vitnemålene eller karakterutskriftene dine. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at all dokumentasjon må være på engelsk eller et skandinavisk språk.


Formelle retningslinjer

De best kvalifiserte søkerne vil bli innkalt til intervju.

Søkerlister kan bli offentliggjort iht. Offentleglova § 25 andre ledd. Når du søker jobb hos oss vil navnet ditt stå på den offentlige søkerlisten. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne listen. Du må begrunne hvorfor du ønsker unntak fra offentliggjøring og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det vil du høre fra oss.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Oslo er Norges eldste og høyest rangerte forsknings- og utdanningsinstitusjon med 26 500 studenter og 7 200 ansatte. Faglig bredde og internasjonalt anerkjente forskningsmiljøer gjør UiO til en viktig samfunnsaktør.

Det matematisk-naturvitenskapelige fakultets (MN) ambisjon er å være blant Europas ledende miljøer innen forskning, utdanning og innovasjon.
Vi har en lang og stolt tradisjon innen forskning og utdanning i de klassiske realfagene. Forskningen spenner over et vidt spekter av fagområder innen alle naturvitenskapene og teknologi.
Fakultet har mange gode forskningsmiljøer og dyktige enkeltforskere, hvorav flere er i forskningsfronten innen sine fag internasjonalt. Fakultetet jobber kontinuerlig med å legge til rette for innovasjon fra forskningen.
Bærekraft er grunnlaget for fakultetets aktivitet og en satsning innen bærekraft står helt sentralt.

Fakultetet består av 10 institutter, 14 senter, 800 doktorgradskandidater, 1100 vitenskapelig ansatte, 450 teknisk-/administrativt ansatte og 6000 studenter.

Fakultetsadministrasjonen bistår enhetene ved fakultetet i den daglige drift og har samtidig et overordnet koordineringsansvar for fakultetet som helhet. Administrasjonen har rundt 100 ansatte fordelt på fem seksjoner - studier, forskning, kommunikasjon, HR og økonomi.

title: Psykolog / psykiatrisk sykepleier / sosionom/miljøterapeut
description:
Kautokeino kommune er Norges største kommune med et spennende miljø hvor samisk og norsk går hånd i hånd, innrammet i vakker natur på Finnmarksvidda. Naturen er rik på ressurser med gode muligheter for friluftsliv, jakt og fiske. Kautokeino-samfunnet har forankring i tradisjonelle samiske verdier, og har mange spennende institusjoner med internasjonal kontaktflate. Kautokeino kommune er en tospråklig kommune, og har et variert kultur- og organisasjonsliv.
Kautokeino kommune - veiviseren i Sápmi

Kautokeino kommune søker en engasjert og faglig sterk psykolog, psykiatrisk sykepleier, sosionom eller miljøterapeut til en ettårig prosjektstilling i helse og omsorgstjenesten. Prosjektstillingen løper i 12 måneder fra oppstartsdato, med mulighet for forlengelse. Stillingen inngår i kommunens arbeid med psykisk helse og rus, og har som mål å bidra til helhetlige og tilgjengelige tjenester for barn, unge og voksne

Stillingen skal styrke kommunens forebyggende psykiske helsearbeid for barn og unge gjennom lavterskeltiltak, gruppebasert arbeid og tilstedeværelse på arenaer der barn og unge oppholder seg. Målet er å fremme psykisk helse, trygghet og mestring, samt forebygge psykiske vansker, vold, rusproblematikk og utenforskap.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet omfatte:

  • Inngå i det forebyggende helsearbeidet gjennom «Oadjebas Guovdageainnus»
  • delta i arbeidsgruppen som allerede er etablert
  • Bidra til å etablere lavterskel psykisk helsetilbud for barn og unge i skole og ungdomsklubb
  • Planlegge og legge til rette for forebyggende samtalegrupper
  • Bidra til å styrke barn og unges evne til å snakke om vanskelige tema i trygge rammer
  • Være en tilgjengelig og synlig ressurs i skole- og ungdomsmiljøene
  • Samarbeide tett med skole, ungdomsklubb og relevante kommunale tjenester
  • Delta i og bidra til det tverrfaglige forebyggende arbeidet i kommunen
  • Bidra til videreutvikling av kommunens forebyggende strategier innen psykisk helse
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som psykolog eller sykepleier med videreutdanning i psykisk helsearbeid, eller bachelor/master i sosialt arbeid (sosionom), miljøterapeut
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn og/eller unge
  • Kompetanse innen forebyggende og helsefremmende arbeid
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt og kan kompensere for deler av de formelle kvalifikasjonskravene
