title: Expression of Interest  Freelance International Recruiter
description:
Remote | Flexible | Commission-based

Do you enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and helping others take the step towards living and working abroad?

Jobs By Nordics is looking to connect with motivated Freelance International Recruiters who want to work remotely and help candidates find exciting job opportunities across Europe.

We recruit multilingual talent for international companies across Europe and are continuously interested in connecting with people who can help us reach more candidates and make great hires.

Right now, we are especially interested in recruiters who speak Danish, German or Dutch, as we have a strong demand for candidates within these markets.

About Jobs By Nordics

Jobs By Nordics is a recruitment agency specialising in connecting multilingual talent with international employers across Europe.

We help Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Dutch and German speakers find opportunities abroad, with many of our positions located in destinations such as Greece, Spain and Cyprus.

Our vacancies are mainly within:

    Customer Service
    

    Technical Support
    

    Sales
    

    Content Moderation
    

    Travel & Tourism

For many of our candidates, accepting a job through us means more than changing employer. It can mean moving to a new country, meeting new people and starting an entirely new chapter in life.

As a recruiter, you will be an important part of making that happen.

The role

As a Freelance International Recruiter, you will manage your candidates throughout the recruitment journey – from finding and contacting them to supporting them through the recruitment process and towards their relocation and new job abroad.

Your responsibilities can include:

    Finding and attracting candidates through social media, job platforms, your own network and other creative sourcing channels
    

    Proactively reaching out to potential candidates
    

    Screening candidates and understanding their motivation, experience and preferences
    

    Matching candidates with suitable opportunities
    

    Presenting positions and relocation opportunities to candidates
    

    Preparing and supporting candidates through assessments and interviews
    

    Following up and keeping candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process
    

    Supporting candidates ahead of their relocation and job start
    

    Keeping candidate information and recruitment statuses updated

You will have the freedom to develop your own ways of finding candidates while working with the vacancies and recruitment opportunities available through Jobs By Nordics.

Who are we looking for?

First and foremost, we are looking for people who are proactive, independent and good with people.

You should enjoy communicating with new people and be comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting for candidates to come to you.

Fluent English is required.

At the moment, we are particularly interested in people who also speak:

    Danish
    

    German
    

    Dutch

Previous experience within recruitment or sales is an advantage, but it is not necessarily a requirement. The right personality, motivation and ability to connect with people are equally important.

We believe you could be a great fit if you:

    Are comfortable approaching and communicating with new people
    

    Are proactive and enjoy finding your own ways to reach candidates
    

    Have a good understanding of social media and online communities
    

    Are organised and good at following up
    

    Can work independently and take responsibility for your own results
    

    Enjoy working with people from different countries and cultures
    

    Have lived or worked abroad, or have a genuine interest in international opportunities
    

    Are motivated by a performance-based way of working

Work remotely – with freedom and responsibility

The collaboration is fully remote, giving you the freedom to work from wherever suits you.

As a freelancer, you decide how you organise your working day and how you approach your candidate sourcing. At the same time, successful recruitment requires consistency, good follow-up and the ability to take ownership of your candidates throughout the process.

Jobs By Nordics provides access to recruitment opportunities, information about the positions and employers, and the tools and support needed to successfully guide candidates through the process.

Commission-based freelance collaboration

The role is commission-based, meaning your earnings are directly connected to your successful recruitments.

This is a freelance collaboration rather than an employment position. You therefore need to have your own registered company or equivalent business structure that allows you to invoice Jobs By Nordics for your services.

As an independent freelancer, you are responsible for managing and complying with the tax, social security, VAT, insurance and other applicable legal requirements in the country where you operate.

Why work with Jobs By Nordics?

You get the opportunity to combine recruitment with the freedom of working independently and remotely.

You can focus on what recruiters do best – finding great people, building relationships and making successful placements – while recruiting for real opportunities with international employers across Europe.

And perhaps most importantly, the people you recruit are often making a major life decision.

You are not simply helping someone find another job.

You might be helping them start a new life abroad.

Interested?

We would love to hear from you.

Send us your Expression of Interest and tell us a little about yourself, the languages you speak, your background and why you believe you would be successful as a Freelance International Recruiter.

We are especially interested in hearing how you would approach finding and engaging candidates for international opportunities.

Join our freelance recruiter network and help more people discover their next opportunity abroad.

title: Lead Design Engineer HIP
description:
About Bodycote

At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen.

The Role

As Lead Design Engineer you will act as the senior technical authority, directing design, supplier management, delivery, commissioning and lifecycle support activities for design/make of global Bodycote HIP hot zone systems. Leading the design engineering team entails directing project management from concept to internal customer handover, and ensuring high-quality, consistent outputs on time and within budget. In addition, you will ensure alignment of design with business goals and become a specialist in holistic HIP system behaviour. You report to Head of Engineering, HIP Europe.

The key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

    

Mentoring and directing team members & conducting performance reviews etc.

    

Implementing structure & best practices in design functional management

    

Define & select appropriate design tool sets, and embed standards/guidelines

    

Ensure design data is correctly configuration controlled & managed using PLM principles

    

Managing projects, setting priorities, and ensuring work aligns with timelines, budgets and product performance expectations.

    

Working with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering teams to align designs with business goals and documenting design decisions appropriately

    

Ensure solutions are technically & economically feasible, meeting safety/legal standards

    

Travel to HIP sites when needed to support production delivery, problem solving and improvement, and visit suppliers as necessary

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who brings:

    

Strong experience of the engineering design process & disciplines over several years

    

Ability to read, write, and speak English and Swedish

    

Degree in mechanical design engineering or equivalent experience

    

Experience working with complex mechanical components & assemblies

    

Proficiency in 3D CAD, design data control, finite element analysis systems etc.

    

Good team player with collaborative attitude and a flexible approach

    

Self-motivated, organised and able to work under pressure to a schedule

    

Good problem solving skills, receptive to different viewpoints

Advantageous characteristics:

    

Team leadership

    

Experience of SOLIDWORKS

    

Experience working with heat treatment, gas handling, & complex tooling

    

Understanding of gas behaviour, heat & mass transfer

    

Experience of design & risk reduction techniques like DFMEA

What’s In It for You

    

Career progression opportunities within a global organisation

    

Exposure to international projects and change initiatives

    

A supportive, inclusive culture where your development matters

    

The opportunity to help shape the next chapter of our business

    

Competitive salary and benefits package

Location & Work Pattern

This role is a full time, permanent position based in Surahammar, with hybrid expectations. Some travel is required depending on business needs.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of characteristics protected by local law, including (where applicable) gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, and ethnic origin. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.

We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.

What you'll do

Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

    

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

    

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

    

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

    

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

    

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

    

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

    

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.

Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.

What we're looking for

    

You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

    

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

    

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

    

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

    

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

    

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

    

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)

Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS

IaC - Terraform

CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Languages - Python, TypeScript

AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)

Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)

What we offer

    

Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

    

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

    

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

    

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

    

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

    

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

    

Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

    

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

    

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

    

Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.

    

Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

    

Contact: Andrew Crookston, VP of Engineering

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Project Manager - Medium Voltage Switchgear
description:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of customer projects within medium-voltage switchgear solutions, leading deliveries from order to completion. We are looking for a driven and technically minded project manager who enjoys taking responsibility, solving challenges, and creating value for customers. Whether your background is in project management, engineering, design, installation, or service, your technical understanding and ability to drive projects successfully are what matter most.

This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions (ELDS) business in Sweden.

You will be mainly accountable for:

    Leading and coordinating project activities throughout the entire project lifecycle.
    Managing project scope, schedule, changes, costs, and quality to achieve project objectives.
    Collaborating closely with customers and our factories and suppliers to ensure effective communication and successful project delivery.

Our team dynamics

You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable team where teamwork, technical expertise, and customer focus are key success factors. We support each other, share knowledge, and work together to deliver high-quality solutions to our customers.

Qualifications for the role

    You have experience leading technical projects and taking ownership of project execution from customer order to final delivery.
    Experience within medium-voltage systems, switchgear solutions, power distribution, or related electrical infrastructure is highly valued.
    You possess a strong technical understanding, gained either through project management roles or hands-on experience as an engineer, designer, technician, installer, service engineer, or similar technical positions.
    You have experience working closely with customers, suppliers, and multiple stakeholders, and you are comfortable building trust-based relationships.
    Experience working in SAP is required.

title: Master Thesis Project  Material Characterization
description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master thesis project within the R&D Materials and Technology Department, focusing on material characterization of cemented carbide cutting tools for high-performance machining applications.

Background  

Composite materials composed of a hard ceramic phase-traditionally tungsten carbide-and a ductile binder phase, typically cobalt, are commonly referred to as hard materials or cemented carbides. These materials are produced using a powder metallurgy process that includes wet milling, spray drying, compaction, and sintering.

Cemented carbides offer an attractive combination of high hardness and toughness. By adjusting grain size and binder content, their properties can be tailored to meet specific application needs.

With a strong focus on sustainability and circularity, the production and use of recycled cemented carbides contribute to reducing environmental impact and improving resource efficiency.

Work description  

In this project, you investigate plastic deformation in cemented carbide cutting inserts, with a particular focus on how deformation varies across the cutting edge region. Previous studies show that plastic deformation is highly heterogeneous and strongly dependent on the specific location analyzed. This variability highlights the need for large-area characterization to obtain representative and reliable results.

The project involves advanced microstructural characterization using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) over large, stitched areas. A central focus is to systematically map and analyse deformation across extended regions beneath the cutting edge, rather than relying on small, localized observations.

You apply Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) to quantify local plastic deformation through Kernel Average Misorientation (KAM) analysis, providing insights into local strain and dislocation density. In addition, SEM image analysis is used to identify and evaluate deformation-related features such as binder redistribution, shear band formation, and microstructural heterogeneity.

Overall, the project aims to enhance the understanding of how plastic deformation develops in cutting tools and how it can be reliably quantified using large-area SEM and EBSD-based techniques. The work is also closely connected to the ongoing European project AIM-NEXT, which focuses on the design and implementation of non-CRM hard materials for next-generation extreme applications. (https://www.aimnext.eu/)

Your background  

We’re looking for a highly motivated student in Materials Science or a related field. A curious mindset, a structured approach to work, and the ability to independently carry out laboratory tasks after initial training are essential. Prior laboratory experience is considered an advantage, as is familiarity with SEM.

As part of the thesis, you present your results both orally and in a written report in English, making strong English communication skills essential.

Duration of the project  

The thesis project runs for 20 weeks, with a flexible start date that is agreed upon with the student. On-site presence in Fagersta is required, although some work may be carried out remotely by agreement. Accommodation is provided, and the project includes a one-time compensation.

title: Master Thesis Project  Material Science
description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master’s thesis project within the R&D Materials Development group, focusing on the sintering kinetics of recycled cemented carbide. The project combines materials science, sintering behavior, and material properties related to the sintering process.

We offer a great workplace with access to state-of-the-art R&D facilities and collaboration with a top-tier research team. You gain valuable experience in materials science, including Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Electron Backscatter Detector (EBSD) and various materials characterization techniques.

Background and scope of the project

Circularity in the carbide industry is essential for reducing CO₂ emissions and lowering costs due to the limited resources of tungsten and cobalt. This project explores how increasing the proportion of recycled cemented carbide powder impacts the sintering process. Today, recycling worn-out carbide tools is well established, with cemented carbide powders containing up to 50–100% recycled material depending on grade and availability.

Work description:

    Conduct sintering experiments in lab scale furnace
    Measuring:
    Magnetic properties (related WC grain size and carbon balance)
    Dimension (shrinkage control quality related)
    Hardness of the sintered cemented carbide (Standard Vickers method)
    Toughness of the cemented carbide (crack resistance by Palmqvist method)
    SEM analysis of structure (WC grain size EBSD)
    Analysis of results
    Thesis writing

The experimental factors are set up with the statistical method Design of Experiments (DOE) in collaboration with the supervisor at Seco. Conducted at the Fagersta production site, the study is experimental including analysis and supported by both the R&D team and production technicians. 

Your profile  

We’re looking for a curious and technology driven MSc student with a focus on material science or material chemistry. Knowledge in metallurgy, physics, mechanical engineering, and similar skills are valuable. Previous experience with SEM and EBSD is advantageous, along with analytical and mathematical skills. Acting in an international environment, good English skills are essential.

Duration of the project

This thesis project lasts for 22 weeks with a flexible start date, preferably around January 19th, 2027. We offer you accommodation in Fagersta and you receive payment when finalizing the thesis. You’ll also present your findings both written and verbally.

title: Key Account Manager, Powerbox

Responsibility and tasks

    Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients in the assigned territory.

    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Personality

    A highly motivated and results-driven individual with a strong work ethic.

title: Tech deployment sr specialist
description:
Location: Gothenburg or Kungälv, Sweden

Working Pattern: Hybrid, 3-5 days on-site per week

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Join our Information Technology team and help shape the digital capabilities that accelerate PMI’s smoke-free transformation. As a Tech Deployment Senior Specialist, you will support the regional deployment of technology solutions by coordinating rollout activities, ensuring site and business readiness, supporting adoption, and securing a smooth transition from project delivery into stable operations.



Impact You'll Own

    Drive regional deployment of technology solutions across markets, sites and business functions.
    Ensure factory and site needs are understood, represented and addressed when central or regional solutions are deployed.
    Identify and escalate functional, operational or support gaps between standard solutions and local business requirements.
    Support simplification of the local technology portfolio by standardizing, consolidating, transitioning or retiring local solutions where possible.
    Secure operational stability through clear ownership, adoption, hypercare and transition from project delivery to support.



What You'll Do

    Plan, coordinate and follow up deployment activities for regional technology initiatives.
    Work closely with factories and stakeholders to understand operational needs, readiness, risks and business impact.

    Maintain ownership of the local application and solution portfolio, including usage, criticality, lifecycle risks and decommissioning opportunities.

Skills & Capabilities

    Experience in technology deployment, rollout coordination or implementation of business-critical systems.

    Ability to lead or coordinate projects and cross-functional initiatives.
    Understanding of application portfolio management, lifecycle planning, simplification and decommissioning.
    Strong coordination skills across business, technology, vendors, delivery teams and support organizations.
    Knowledge of change management, adoption, hypercare and transition from project delivery to stable operations.



Rewards & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive rewards package including collective barging agreement, health insurance, occupational pension, 30 vacation days a year, a generous sport allowance and beneficial parental leave to name a few.

You will also have the opportunity to grow your career in a global organization, contribute to meaningful transformation, and be part of a team working towards a smoke-free future.



Application Process

To join our team, apply before the 11th of September. Submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated confidentially and screened on an on-going basis. Relocation support is not offered for this role.

The recruitment process consists of phone screening, online assessments, and at least two interview stages.

We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know—we’re here to help you succeed.

    Vocational training in IT or a related field.

    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    1–3 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, or Technical
    Support role.
    Experience working with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools such as Jira
    Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
    Good understanding of ITIL-based incident and request management processes.
    Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic networking issues.
    A valid Category B driving licence.
    The ability to understand and communicate in Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is considered an advantage.
    Experience administering Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online, is considered an advantage.

Personal Qualities

We’re looking for someone who:

    Delivers professional and customer-focused support.
    Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical users.
    Takes initiative and approaches problems in a structured way.
    Is organised and pays attention to detail.
    Works well with colleagues and external partners.

Why Join Us?

You’ll become part of a collaborative IT team where your work has a direct impact on employees’ daily experience. We offer a supportive environment that values continuous learning, teamwork, and professional development, giving you opportunities to grow your technical skills while helping shape and improve our IT services.

If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy helping people, and want to be part of a dynamic IT support team, we’ll love to hear from you.

About Avincis

Avincis is one of the world’s leading operators in emergency aviation services and the largest in Europe. We operate more than 180 bases across Spain, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, Mozambique, and Chile.

Our fleet consists of approximately 205 aircraft — 165 helicopters and 40 fixed-wing aircraft — used in critical missions every day. We save lives, protect communities, and support essential services, from air ambulance and search & rescue to wildfire suppression and government operations.

With over 3,000 employees across Europe, we combine the precision and speed of aviation with a strong sense of purpose: making a difference when it truly matters.

Come and join Avincis and help keep air ambulance services safe and efficient across the Nordic region!

title: Au Pair Wanted – Arabic-Speaking
description:
Au Pair Wanted – Arabic-Speaking, Part-Time Position in Sweden

We are looking for a warm, responsible and caring Arabic-speaking au pair to become part of our family in Sweden.

We are especially interested in someone who comes from an Arabic-speaking country, would like to study in Sweden and is interested in learning more about Swedish culture and everyday life. Ideally, you are already living in Sweden, but we are open to the right person who is planning to move here.

About the role

The position is part-time, as the children stay with us every other week. The main responsibilities would include:

    

Helping with school drop-offs and pick-ups

    

Spending time with the children and being a caring, positive adult presence

    

Helping with simple everyday tasks around the home

    

Supporting the children with homework and everyday routines when needed

    

Speaking Arabic with the children and helping them develop and maintain their Arabic language skills

    

Introducing the children to Arabic language, culture and traditions

Because helping the children learn and maintain Arabic is an important part of the role, fluent Arabic is a requirement.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who is:

    

Fluent in Arabic

    

Caring, responsible and reliable

    

Good with children

    

Comfortable helping with everyday household tasks

    

Interested in studying and/or building a life in Sweden

    

Curious about Swedish culture and willing to become part of our family life

    

Ideally already living in Sweden

    

Previous experience with children is a plus

The position is not full-time. You would work every other week, which makes this a good opportunity for someone who is studying or has other commitments during the weeks when the children are not with us.

Accommodation

If you need accommodation, we may be able to arrange housing, depending on the circumstances.

We hope to find someone who is looking for more than just a job — someone who would enjoy becoming part of our family, sharing their language and culture with our children, while also experiencing Swedish culture and everyday life.

If you are interested, please send us a little information about yourself, your background, your experience with children, your plans for studying in Sweden, and your current living situation.

title: Software Developer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic team as a Software Developer in the GCO EN D&S PMO, where you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our COMOS engineering platform. Imagine designing and implementing software solutions that not only support our internal R&D initiatives but also cater to external customer projects. You will engage in hands-on development and provide technical project support, collaborating closely with a diverse network of stakeholders. Your ability to manage complex projects and translate engineering requirements into robust software solutions will be key to your success. Get ready to immerse yourself in a collaborative environment where your contributions will drive innovation and excellence!

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Design and develop tailored software solutions on the COMOS Aries engineering platform to fulfill specific R&D and customer project needs.
    Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for solution designs, data models, and system integrations.
    Lead the evaluation and selection of technologies and methodologies to enhance the engineering tool ecosystem’s functionality and performance.
    Implement and manage system configurations, customizations, and integrations based on approved architectural designs.
    Perform advanced troubleshooting and debugging to resolve complex technical issues within the application and its interfaces.
    Manage source code and deployment packages using version control and CI/CD pipelines.
    Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and customers to define technical scope, deliverables, and timelines.
    Provide expert-level technical guidance and support to project teams and end-users during implementation and operational phases.
    Coach and mentor junior developers and team members on software development best practices and platform-specific knowledge.
    Foster close collaboration and support for our Engineering Systems team and its Business Analysts.

What You Bring

    Proven experience with C#, .NET Framework, WPF, and GIT.
    Demonstrated ability to manage large, complex software projects or processes with minimal oversight.
    Experience in developing custom solutions within an existing framework of a third-party application.
    Familiarity with Kanban and Scrum methodologies, including tools like Azure DevOps and Jira.
    Knowledge of AI/LLM assisted development, including its possibilities and pitfalls.
    Experience with web API integrations and asynchronous programming.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills.
    An open mindset that values new ideas, positive thinking, and problem-solving.
    A structured approach to continuous improvement in work processes.
    Interest in collaborating with individuals from diverse backgrounds and cultures.
    Proficiency in Swedish and English is required.
    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Snowflake, or other data lake solutions, as well as large database management, migration, and data extraction is a plus.
    Familiarity with additional programming languages (such as VB, Python, etc.) is advantageous.

About the Team
You will be part of the SE D GCO EN D&S PMO management team, which consists of three specialized teams: Project Management, Engineering Systems, and Technical Information Systems. Together, we work collaboratively to drive project success and deliver innovative solutions that meet our customers’ needs.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

description:

    Create and issue 3-week lookahead schedules every week
    Manage, plan, organize, implement, and control all construction activities of the project per the Project Schedule
    Track inventory regularly
    Be the primary contact on site for construction & liaison with head office on issues relating to the project progress

    Plan to prevent problems and mitigate emerging ones.

    Ensure that company policies, procedures, standards, etc., are followed
    Site subcontractor management & implementation of HSE (Healthy, Safety & Environmental)
    Ensure site progress as per schedule. If there are delays, initiate the necessary actions like allocating extra resources or alternative work processes to ensure the schedule is back on track
    Report progress to the project manager
    Provide a daily & monthly progress report & update the schedule for submission to the customer
    Discuss with the project team and propose/resolve customer and site-related issues
    Work with the site sub-contractor to the standards at the site and maintain alignment with the customer
    Attend customer meetings, contractor meetings, and provide direction
    Ensure timely disposition of the site contractor queries
    Identify and mitigate risks that may have an impact on the project
    Inform the project manager of issues that may affect project profit, costs, schedules, and client relations
    Ensure maintenance of daily records of all site activities, including information on labor and plant, and any non-compliant materials or workmanship
    Monitor project cost and provide the Project Manager with timely identification of deviations from the budget
    Evaluate the change orders/scope change requests of the subcontractor & provide inputs to the project manager
    In case of any accidents, damages, or emergencies at the site, ensure that the proper protocol & procedure



Skill Requirements:

    Proficient in reading the Engineering drawings and documents
    Proficient with computer programs, including MS Office suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook), Blue Beam, Navisworks, and navigating 3D models
    Knowledge of project control software such as Microsoft Project & Primavera P6 is preferred
    Experience in water/wastewater treatment preferred
    OSHA standards and other site safety practices
    Organization and priority-defining skills
    Ability to listen, communicate (written and oral), and willingness to collaborate
    Communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands:

Lifting/carrying/moving 50 lbs, may need to climb ladders, cannot be afraid of heights, and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. Involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.



Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management is preferred
    Ten (10) or more years of construction-related experience

title: Director, Business Development Data Centers
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Build early commercial partnerships across the data centre marketWould you like to shape how NKT engages with customers across the growing data centre segment? As Director, Business Development Data Centers, you will establish early commercial relationships, develop qualified opportunities and coordinate a OneNKT approach across business lines. This international role offers the opportunity to support NKT’s growth journey while contributing to the infrastructure needed for the green transition.



Develop strategic data centre opportunities across selected marketsYou will manage front-end business development across the data centre ecosystem, engaging customers and partners before formal tendering begins. By understanding customer priorities and coordinating internal stakeholders, you will help shape commercial positioning and prepare qualified opportunities for handover to the relevant business line. You will also contribute to NKT’s data centre go-to-market strategy and provide structured insights into market dynamics, customer needs, competitors and portfolio gaps.Your responsibility will be to:




    Map and prioritise target customers, projects and decision-makers
    Build relationships with developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators and OEMs
    Develop and manage qualified opportunities through early customer engagement
    Coordinate customer activities across NKT business lines and functions
    Support partnership discussions, market analysis and management updates



The position may be based in London, Runcorn, Teesside, Cologne, Berlin, Malmö, Karlskrona or Copenhagen. Planned travel of more than 50 days per year is expected, including customer meetings, industry forums and partner discussions.

Profile description:

Commercial relationship builder with a collaborative working styleYou communicate clearly with people at different organisational levels and create trust through a consistent and considered approach. You are comfortable working across functions, balancing several stakeholder perspectives and maintaining structure as opportunities develop. Curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to translate discussions into practical next steps will help you work effectively in an international and matrix-based organisation.You also have:




    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
    Experience in business development, strategic sales, key account management or go-to-market roles within electrical infrastructure, electrical components or power solutions
    Experience with complex solution selling
    Established network and experience within the data centre ecosystem, including developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators or OEMs
    A record of developing senior external and internal relationships and early-stage commercial opportunities
    Fluent English



Connect data centre growth with the green transitionWe aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This role offers opportunities for professional development in a collaborative, international setting. You will expand your knowledge of the data centre value chain, work with colleagues across several business lines and develop your commercial and strategic capabilities. You will also contribute to NKT’s market approach within a growing infrastructure segment connected to the green transition.“As a leader, I believe in giving you the freedom to manage tasks while being available to support you when needed. I appreciate work-life balance and aim to build an environment that supports it", says Hiring Manager, Simone Pagliuca







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 9th of September. Please submit your application in English. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests will be included in the recruitment process. title: EY-Parthenon Manager | People M&A Nordics
description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for a Manager with experience from M&A projects to join our Nordic People M&A team. The role is part of our Nordic practice and can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, working closely with colleagues and clients globally.





Your key responsibilities



As a Manager in EY-Parthenon’s dedicated People M&A practice, you will work with some of the leading HR and pension specialists advising and supporting corporate and private equity clients in transactions. You will support and guide our clients through a broad range of complex people matters across the entire deal cycle, including HR and pension due diligence, ensuring readiness for day one, and achieving synergies in post-merger integrations. Some of the key responsibilities include:

    Prepare due diligence reports on HR, including analysis of target company data to identify key people related financial exposures in a due diligence context, such as workforce costs and future liabilities, retention risks among key employees, side-by-side benefits comparison, and assessment of incentives programs, among other things
    Collaborate with EY colleagues and client executives to address people related issues in carve-outs, signing-to-closing and post-deal integration phases (e. g, HR operating model implementation, organizational design, union consultation strategies, compensation planning) to ensure seamless employee transitions
    Support the evaluation, design, and development of retention strategies that align compensation, benefits and incentives for executives and key employees with overarching acquisition goals
    Mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture





Skills and attributes for success



    Excellent communication skills in English required, both verbal and written
    4-7 years of experience in transactions or strategy consulting
    Quantitative mindset with a focus on delivering excellent work in a fast-paced environment
    Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
    Strong interest in the financial aspects of people/HR topics, including compensation and benefits and/or pensions





Ideally, you’ll also



    Have expertise in financial analysis of HR costs and liabilities from annual reports and internal financial statements
    Experience working with senior stakeholders on HR M&A programmes
    Previous M&A experience, ideally with a focus on people-related matters, e.g. Due Diligence, post-deal integration, compensation & benefits, organisation design, competence strategy and fulfilment, change- and/or culture programs
    Experience in analysing and assessing pension plans





What we look for



    An agile, business and growth-oriented mindset. We’re looking for innovative individuals who can work in an agile way and adapt to a changing business environment
    Curiosity and a purpose-driven approach. We seek people who see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to build a better working world
    Inclusivity. We value individuals who embrace diverse perspectives and work inclusively to build safety and trust





What we offer you



We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and to help build a better working world. Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



Please submit your application no later than 13th of September 2026. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marcus Nylén at marcus.nylen@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com.



Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.



EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
TL;DR You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. title: Registrar - Security Registry
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realize amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Do you want to contribute to security at one of Sweden's most high-tech companies? Security is prioritized, on top management's agenda and crucial for competitiveness, profitability and trust in a challenging global market.

Saab Naval Security Department is looking for a Registrar responsible for the Security Registry in Lund. As the role involves handling classified information and physical security-related processes, the work is primarily carried out on-site.

In this role, you will work hands-on with security-related administration and especially the management of classified defence information, where attention to detail makes a real difference.

You ensure that classified defence documents are registered, distributed, archived and inventoried in accordance with established regulations. You will also support encryption tasks, manage cryptographic keys and perform administrative tasks such as IT-certificate management and task management administration.

Your work impacts both colleagues and business operations, as the role is part of several interconnected security processes. The role involves coordination with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Saab's security organization and act as a backup function for Security Registries within the Business Area.

You are comfortable using the English language and flexible to travel within the position. You will be part of the Security Office within the Naval Security Department and report to the Head of Security Office.

Business Area Naval provides the most efficient platforms on and under the sea, both for the military and civilian domain. The portfolio covers submarines, surface ships, combat boats, under-surface vessels, torpedoes and more. Within Saab Security, we have anchored a Saab-wide ambition to become world leading in security risk management and to be referred to by other security professionals as the company having the best practices in place.

The Security Department at Business Area Naval is a team consisting of competences such as Security Managers, Information Security Specialists, Security Officers and Security Protection Specialists.

Your profile

To be successful in this role, you are structured and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and integrity. You take pride in delivering high-quality work and have an eye for documentation standards and administrative accuracy. Experience working with the Swedish Security Protection Act, classified information, or in regulated environments is meriting.

You are reliable and possess strong problem-solving abilities. You are comfortable handling both complex assignments and routine administrative tasks and approach your work with professionalism and commitment. You actively seek opportunities to improve ways of working, both within the department and across the business in relation to the security protection.

The role involves a significant amount of independent work, and you enjoy taking ownership of your responsibilities while remaining an engaged member of a broader security organization. You can adapt your communication style to different audiences and communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.

Your profile will be extra interesting if you possess any of the following:

    

Educated Registrar/Archivist, or equivalent professional experience

    

Curious about national and international security protection matters

    

Experience in communications security and cryptography (COMSEC) / encryption systems

Personal qualities are of great importance, and it is essential that you are trustworthy and act with strong ethics.

You understand the need for balanced security in a business-driven environment. As a Registrar at Saab Naval, you are likely to get in contact with classified information.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance, additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

If you are interested in what benefits you can take part of as an employee at Saab in Sweden, you can read more about them here.

Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Pastry Chef - Sheraton Stockholm

Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.

We have currently just finished a full renovation of the property with the intention of re-position the hotel in line with its iconic history among the luxury hotels in the city.

Over the past 9 months we have opened 463 newly renovated rooms, a large meeting room floor with 12 different meeting spaces, a high-end wellness club and 3 different unique food & beverage outlets. The american brasserie Mr. Bronck, the 70's disco inspired cocktail bar Sally's and the performance focused Juice Bar Juicy Jane's.


The right candidate is someone who is an experienced pastry chef and loves all things dessert. You are an unpretentious team player who has a passion for exceeding guest's expectations and creating memorable experiences through food.

This role will lead the planning, preparation, and execution of the pastry and bakery operations of the hotel which supplies our various outlets (restaurant, bars, breakfast, banqueting) in connection with our head chefs.

●       Lead our pastry/bakery operation and oversee the production of high-quality desserts and pastries in line with our concepts.
●       To change menus seasonally and support the development of our concepts according to the business needs.
●       To help calculate the cost and price menus accordingly.
●       Take an innovative approach in the development of new recipes while maintaining consistency in quality and presentation.
●       To develop a strategy plan for the minimization of food wastage in your area of the kitchen.
●       To oversee the daily ordering of the necessary pastry food products.
●       To perform inventory duties for bakery related products on a monthly basis.
●       To overview the HACCP control of our operation in your section ensuring we are adhering to the set regulations.
●       Act on pastry related guest requests and problems in a manner that follows the hotels vision and policies


Background and personal characteristics:

You are a creative team player highly experienced in menu development who thrives in a high-pace kitchen operation making exceptionally high quality food.

In addition,

●       Experience as a Pastry Chef, with at least 3-5 years within a high-quality kitchen operation in hotels or restaurants.
●       Culinary degree or formal pastry chef training is required.
●       Strong knowledge of classical and modern pastry techniques, baking methods, and presentation.
●       Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
●       Passion for creating innovative and visually appealing desserts.
●       Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
●       Understanding of inventory management and cost control.
●       Creative personality who enjoys developing concepts and thinking outside the box.
●       Experienced in developing high quality menus.
●       Ambitious and interested in working in a high-pace environment with great standards.
●       Good sense of service and a genuine desire to exceed guests' and employees' expectations.
●       High professional ethics.
●       Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus.



What We Offer:


    A permanent full-time position following the 6-month probation period and we adhere to collective bargaining agreements.
    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene.
    Great opportunities for career growth.
    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
    Employee discounted rates at over 8,000 hotels worldwide.

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

title: Android Developer, Sesam App, Solna
description:
Sesam is PostNord's platform for digital access to parcel lockers and other digitally locked delivery spaces across the Nordics.

As part of PostNord's growing Out of Home delivery network, Sesam enables secure and seamless interactions between customers, delivery personnel and a wide range of locker solutions.

Behind the simple user experience lies a complex technical environment involving mobile apps, APIs, backend services, third-party SDKs, Bluetooth-enabled hardware and integrations with multiple locker providers across Nordic markets.

We're now looking for an experienced Android Developer to join our team and help shape the future of our Out of Home network.

About the Role

As an Android Developer, you will build and maintain mobile solutions that communicate with backend services, APIs, third-party SDKs and physical hardware.

You'll work with:

    Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

    Bluetooth communication and device integrations

    REST APIs and backend services

    Background processing and synchronization

    CI/CD, testing and modern development practices

You will also contribute to architecture discussions, technical decisions and the future evolution of the Sesam platform.

Who You Are

You are a proactive problem-solver who takes ownership and enjoys collaborating with others. You are curious, open to new ideas and focused on creating solutions that are simple, stable and maintainable.

You believe great software is built through teamwork, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

We believe you have:

    BSc in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience

    5+ years of mobile development experience

    Strong Android development experience, in either Kotlin and/or Java

    Experience with Jetpack Compose

    Experience with asynchronous and reactive programming

    Experience integrating REST APIs and backend services

    Experience with Bluetooth communication

    Experience integrating third-party SDKs

    Experience with CI/CD, testing and modern development practices

    Professional proficiency in English

Nice to Have

    iOS development (Swift/SwiftUI)

    Experience with IoT or hardware-connected applications

    Authentication and secure access solutions

    Multi-vendor integrations

    BigQuery, Looker Studio or similar analytics tools

    Proficiency in Swedish or another Scandinavian language

About usWe move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

What are you waiting for? Send in your application. Selection is ongoing, so apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact manager malin.rydman@postnord.comWe look forward to hearing from you!

Read more about our union representatives

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

title: Senior Technical Process Executive
description:
Role: Technical Support Specialist

Location: Helsingborg, Sweden

Position Summary

Provide 1st level technical support, service restoration, fulfillment of service request and advice to users ensuring the maximum availability, performance and utilization of knowledge and information systems.

Follow a systematic, disciplined and analytical approach to problem solving to meet set standards and agreed procedures. Executes transactions as per prescribed timelines.

Provide 1st measure analysis of issues and inputs for problem management. Leverages best effort method for issue resolution through cross functional coordination and support team lead in training, reviews and escalation handling.

Analytical and Problem-solving skills

    Active listening and questioning, an eye for detail to determine the root cause of the issue, to avoid repeat contacts and further effort to resolve issues
    Analytical problem solvers who will understand issues, evaluate solutions and work with their colleagues to resolve issues
    Problem solving skills and quick thinking to own & resolve issues independently, thoroughly & efficiently
    Display ownership and accountability
    Quickly build trust and confidence with customer
    Own and resolve customer issues efficiently, effectively and empathetically

Mandatory requirement for experienced candidates:

    Min. 24 months’ work experience in Service Desk/ Tech support process providing remote support for Laptops / Desktops / LAN Issues / Application support/ Small Forms etc.
    Intermediate knowledge of T/S OS (Windows XP-10), Browsers, MS Office suite
    Intermediate knowledge of T/S Small Forms (iOS, Andrioid, Windows)
    Experience of working within a busy ICT Service Desk environment, showing experience of systems, support, diagnostic and resolution.
    Intermediate knowledge of Registry Fix, Patch upgrades, Virus T/S, Security, Encryptions
    Intermediate knowledge of Network collaborations & VPN T/S
    Basic networking knowledge

Additional Preferred skills:

    PBX Administration Avaya or similar
    Anti-Virus & IT Security best practices implementation & administration
    Process compliance Knowledge of the ITIL Framework
    Knowledge of McAfee products

Communication & Relationships Skills

    To deliver a first line support service via the Service Desk, receiving incidents and service requests from various routes including telephone, web tickets, chat and e mail.  
    Offering advice to end users on all IT related areas. This will include working as part of a team, in order to share knowledge and work together to increase performance standards.  

Skills & Knowledge

    Communicate at all levels
    Ability to work across organizational and professional boundaries
    Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    High level of interpersonal skills, including active listening and understanding
    Good organizational skills and ability to prioritize workloads.
    Work to tight deadlines / service levels
    Business etiquette
    Broad knowledge of IT products, services and terminology

Job duties and responsibilities

    To improve user confidence in the areas of computer hardware & software, applications, being empathetic to a variety of new and experienced learners needs.
    Help to implement and improve processes and procedures within the team allowing strong service focused deliverables.
    Actively troubleshoot to identify, assess, record, resolve and / or escalate incidents and service requests ensuring they are handled within an agreed time limit, within agreed processes and in a professional and customer sensitive manner.
    To participate in an on-call rota, providing 24 hours, first line support service to users.
    To deliver a first line support service via the Service Desk, receiving incidents and service requests from various routes including telephone, intranet and e mail.
    Update incidents with detailed and relevant information in a timely and effective manner;
    Provide updates to customers with regards to specific incidents and manage a trouble ticket through to resolution;
    Escalate an incident or troubleshoot tickets according to the company escalation processes;
    Ensure Customer Service Level Agreements are met or exceeded;
    Respond to customer enquiries in a timely and efficient manner;
    Ensure appropriate documentation of the interaction on the customer’s account in the prescribed format
    Execute transactions as per prescribed guidelines and timelines
    Ensure customer/user confidentiality and data protection at all times

Education and other requirement

    Engineering Graduate/ B.Sc. Computer Science / or Graduate with any technical degree/ diploma required.
    ITIL trained preferred
    Willingness to work in rotational shifts

About Infosys

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 59 countries to navigate their digital transformation.

With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer clients, in 59 countries, as they navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and AI. We enable them with an AI-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. We are deeply committed to being a well-governed, environmentally sustainable organization where diverse talent thrives in an inclusive workplace.

All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer
